jobs.title: Program Lead, Airports & Venues CX
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
  
Airports and venues are Uber's highest-stakes customer experience moments. Airports alone account for approximately 15% of Uber's Mobility Gross Bookings globally - a disproportionate share driven by our premium portfolio, high-value riders, and the structural complexity of airport operations across 100+ priority hubs worldwide. On a platform completing more than 40 million trips every day, airport journeys punch well above their weight: they disproportionately shape how business travelers, tourists, and premium users perceive Uber. A single poor experience at a priority hub doesn't just generate a support ticket; it drives churn among the cohort most likely to be first-trip riders, most likely to upgrade to premium products, and most likely to become long-term brand advocates.
  
  
The Airports & Venues CX program owns the global strategy to eliminate that friction at scale. We sit at the intersection of Ops, Product, and CX - translating on-the-ground airport complexity (staging lots, regulatory constraints, fare structures, matching algorithms, wayfinding failures) into systemic, data-driven solutions that reduce defects across the top 100+ priority airports worldwide including venues.
  
  
As **Program Lead, Airports & Venues CX** , you will own the global defect reduction program - the most consequential initiative within this domain. You are the person who understands what is driving each basis point of airport defect rates across key issues such as fare disputes, cancellations, lost items or transaction issues at our priority hubs, and builds the cross-functional machine that surfaces customer insights, quantifies root causes drives and advocates for product and on ground improvements to bring that number down - structurally, not episodically.
  
  
This role is ideal for a senior CX, support operations, product operations, or travel operations leader who combines analytical rigor, customer empathy, AI fluency, and deep comfort operating in complex physical environments such as airports, airlines, mobility platforms, hospitality, logistics, or large-scale venues.
  
  
**What you'll do**  
  
**Own the global airport defect reduction program end-to-end.** You will use AI to transform how we detect, diagnose, prevent, and resolve airport CX defects/painful experiences.

* Define and maintain the global defect taxonomy for Airports & Venues - classifying root causes across top issues be it fare disputes or cancellations or lost items across the top priority airports and venues.
* Build and run the global issue tracker: a systematically maintained, owner-assigned, SLA-tracked view of open defects across priority airports - published periodically to global and regional leadership.
* Lead root-cause elimination: move beyond ticket-level fixes to identify structural product, policy, and operational changes that prevent defect categories from recurring. Propose and advocate for product improvements to fix painful experiences upstream.
* Establish defect baselines and reduction targets across the top airports and venues in collaboration with Rider and Driver CX and Ops; and track and present progress periodically and systematically to senior stakeholders.

**Architect and operate the actionable intelligence infrastructure**

* Define the KPIs, parameters, and alerting thresholds to surface emerging friction patterns before they compound.
* Design and own the monthly Global Airport VOC Report - synthesizing rider and driver voice-of-customer signals across EMEA, US&C, LATAM, and APAC into prioritized, actionable insights shared with Ops and Product partners.
* Build real-time, AI generated actionable intelligence that surface which airports are trending in the wrong direction, why, and who owns the resolution. Translate intelligence into targeted VoC packages for Ops partners to drive actionable improvements

**Drive product and tech partnership for structural gap elimination**

* Serve as the primary CX advocate to Product and Engineering for airport-specific improvements.
* Co-own the experimentation roadmap with Product teams: define hypotheses, specify success metrics (defect rate, CSAT, contact rate, refund rate), and read out results to drive feature prioritization.
* Partner downstream with CX tech teams to continually improve support experience and make it more intelligent, empathetic with high resolution quality

**Own policy design and segmentation for Airports & Venues**

* Develop differentiated support models for high-value users (HVUs) at priority hubs: white-glove SLAs, proactive outreach, and faster resolution pathways - in partnership with the broader CX segmentation and tooling teams.
* Collaborate with Rider and Driver customer experience leads to design hyper segmented support policies for priority airports and user segments.
* Lead policy pilots in key priority markets and build the framework for scaling what works globally.
* Ensure policy reflects local regulatory nuances and union-governed access constraints that directly affect fare structures and driver economics.

**Lead senior stakeholder management and influence**

* Serve as the senior interface between global CX leadership and regional execution teams across all four mega-regions. Represent Airports & Venues CX in cross-functional forums - acting as the informed, data-backed voice of CX in airport strategy discussions.
* Present program performance, defect trends, and strategic recommendations to Director and VP-level audiences - with the rigor and clarity to drive decisions, not just inform them.
* Negotiate trade-offs with Product, Ops, and BD on airport CX priorities: be the person who can make the case for why a 10-basis-point improvement in defect rate at LHR justifies a product investment.
* Publish the Global Airport Newsletter (monthly) to Ops and CX stakeholders - establishing the Airports & Venues team as the authoritative intelligence source on airport CX performance globa

**Required Qualifications**

**Patient Success & Growth Coordinator**Pinnacle Wellness Center (Suen Chiropractic) | Pleasanton, CAPart-Time, Weekday Mornings (9am-12pm)

**ABOUT US**

For six years, Pinnacle Wellness Center has been built around a different approach to care. Our lead provider, Dr. Ryan Suen, is a chiropractor who specializes in Applied Kinesiology – using it to find the actual root of what's going on with a patient, instead of running a high-volume adjustment mill. We pair this care with hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) to support the whole picture of our patient’s health. We're growing into a broader wellness center over the next few years, and we're looking for the right person to help us build it.

**THE ROLE**

This is a part-time, Monday through Friday morning position. This person will be the consistent face and voice our patients see from their first conversation with our marketing team all the way through their ongoing care with us. They will pick up where our marketing team leaves off with new patients who've already booked their first visit, run our HBOT chamber sessions, staff the front desk for morning patients, and convert first-time visitors into ongoing patients.

**YOUR TIME, ROUGHLY BROKEN DOWN**

Sales & Patient Conversion (~40%)

* Reach out to new patients after they've booked, to confirm their visit, answer questions, and set expectations for their first appointment including what to bring and wear (comfortable clothing, water, recommendations on what they can do while using the HBOT like reading a book)
* Follow up after a patient's first HBOT/chiro visit to talk through how it went and what's next
* Walk patients through care package and membership options: pricing, payment plans, and answering questions or honest hesitations
* Process payment and enrollment when a patient decides to move forward

Operations (~35%)

* Operate our wellness-grade HBOT chamber for new and returning patients (full training provided, no certification required)
* Staff the front desk for any patient booked in the morning, new or returning

Marketing Support (~20%)

* Social media, review requests, and follow-up outreach during downtime between sessions

Systems & Process (~5%)

* Help build and refine the SOPs behind all of the above as we grow

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

Experience:

* Real sales or closing experience. You're comfortable processing transactions, closing sales, and managing the full sales cycle from start to finish. You’re well-versed in overcoming objections, ensuring a "let me think about it" never stalls the conversation but instead opens the door to a deeper conversation. This is the single most important qualification for this role.

Who You Are:

* You genuinely believe in the mission. You believe in the root-cause and relationship-based care over a high-volume mill.
* Team-oriented and collaborative, yet deeply adaptable; comfortable assessing shifting situations on your own and stepping in to handle them without waiting for direction.
* Reliable, precise follow-through; chamber operation means following the same safety procedure exactly, every time
* Proactive and forward-thinking, with a natural ability to spot small operational gaps and solve them before they become issues.
* Genuinely available Monday through Friday mornings, on an ongoing basis

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Prior experience in healthcare, wellness, or a med-spa-style patient coordinator role
* Interest in helping build SOPs and operational systems as we grow

**SCHEDULE & PAY**

Part-time, Monday through Friday, 9am–12pm shift (15 hours to start, with room to expand toward 20+ hours). Given the morning schedule and the need for reliable, in-person coverage, we're prioritizing candidates based in or near the Tri-Valley (Pleasanton, Dublin, San Ramon, and Livermore) who can consistently make it in without fighting unpredictable traffic.

$23/hour, plus a quarterly bonus tied to how well you're helping new patients follow through into ongoing care – not a per-sale commission. We want someone focused on doing right by the patient and building a real relationship, not chasing individual closes. Room to grow in hours and scope as the practice does.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk Operations
jobs.description:
Trust & Safety - San Francisco

**About the Team**

At OpenAIs of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role will take on new, ambiguous, or underdeveloped operational risks and help mature them into scalable capabilities. We work across USRO and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Legal, Safety, Support, and external vendors or partnership stakeholders.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Operations Analyst to take on complex, ambiguous safety and risk problems and turn them into practical operational solutions that can scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a versatile operator who is comfortable moving between queues, investigation, analysis, workflow design, hands-on execution, and cross-functional leadership. Depending on team needs, the role may focus on emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployment partnerships, or other new operational areas.

You will be expected to move quickly, work hands-on, and create structure without waiting for perfect requirements or a large support team. The work starts with the problem, not a prescribed process. You may investigate unstructured user signals, stand up a lightweight workflow, build an AI-assisted tool, improve an existing operation, or help a new launch become operationally ready. The goal is to produce durable systems that other people can run, not simply complete a series of individual tasks.

The portfolio will change with company priorities and may span established harm areas, emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployments and partnerships, device safety, or new product launches. Some hires may focus primarily on cloud deployment operations, including launch readiness, partner coordination, safety workflows, and operational monitoring. You will typically own a small number of high-impact problems at a time and will be expected to judge what needs to be built, what can stay lightweight, and when the work is ready to scale, transfer, or stop.

Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office.

***Please note:*** *This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.*

**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of ambiguous, high-priority safety and risk problems: define the problem, gather the right evidence, choose a practical path, drive execution, and close the loop.
* Analyze structured and unstructured data, both quantitative and qualitative. This may include user reports, case narratives, conversations, escalations, and operational metrics to identify patterns, risks, and the highest-leverage interventions.
* Build and test lightweight workflows, tools, automations, and decision aids that improve speed, quality, and consistency, then iterate based on real-world use.
* Turn one-off insights and manual work into scalable operating mechanisms without adding unnecessary process or complexity.
* Lead sensitive investigations, incident response, or launch-readiness work, including safety workflows, human review, escalation paths, partner coordination, and operational monitoring for product launches or cloud deployments.
* Work directly with cross-functional and external partners to clarify ownership, resolve operational gaps, and turn incomplete signals into clear recommendations and decisions.
* Measure whether the work is improving outcomes—such as quality, speed, coverage, operator effort, or risk reduction—and adjust quickly when it is not.
* Help junior operators build judgment and independence through coaching, calibration, and reusable tools.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You**

* Have 8+ years of experience in trust and safety operations, investigations, incident response, product operations, technical program management, or another high-judgment, data-heavy operational field.
* Have a track record as a scrappy generalist who can enter an unfamiliar problem, learn quickly, and deliver with limited structure or support.
* Are highly data savvyation and combine it with quantitative evidence.
* Are technically fluent and hands-on with AI tools, dashboards, and data tooling, and can build or prototype practical solutions without waiting for a dedicated technical team.
* Operate independently, make clear tradeoffs, and maintain momentum as priorities and requirements change.
* Think in systems: you look beyond the immediate task and build approaches that can be repeated, measured, and operated by others.
* Exercise strong judgment in sensitive situations involving user impact, policy, legal risk, technical constraints, and business priorities.
* Communicate clearly and directlyal authority.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in trust and safety, fraud, product safety, integrity, or another adversarial or high-severity risk domain.
* Experience moving a new or immature workflow from early investigation into stable, scaled operations.
* Experience supporting cloud platforms or deployment partnerships, enterprise products, product launches, connected devices, or other technically complex programs. Direct cloud experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Familiarity with SQL, lightweight scripting, no-code tools, workflow automation, or AI-assisted development.
* Experience with vendor operations, quality programs, calibrations, or distributed operational teams.

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Enablement Program Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re looking for an **Enablement Program Manager** to build the engine that keeps Outset’s go-to-market teams sharp, current, and ready to win.

This is a **high-ownership role reporting to the VP of Sales**, responsible for enabling our **Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Product Marketing and Solutions teams at scale**. Outset moves fast: new products, new verticals, new competitors, and new use cases land every month. Your job is to turn that change into clear, usable knowledge—and get it into the hands (and heads) of every customer-facing person on the team.

You’ll design **plug-and-play enablement programs** that new content can drop straight into: onboarding, product launches, competitive updates, certifications, and ongoing skills training. You’ll own our **GTM knowledge repository** so the right answer is always easy to find. And you’ll do it by partnering across **GTM, Product, Marketing, G&A, and Leadership**—often without a playbook, and always with a bias toward making it work.

This role is built for a **high-upside, early-career operator**: someone who has already shown they can own programs end to end, teach complex topics clearly, and thrive in ambiguity, and who wants to grow with a category-defining company.

**Responsibilities**

* Own Outset’s **GTM enablement program end to end**: roadmap, calendar, delivery, and measurement.
* Design **repeatable, plug-and-play enablement frameworks** (onboarding, launch kits, competitive updates, certifications) that new content can drop into with minimal rework.
* Build and run **new-hire onboarding** that gets new GTM team members ramped and customer-ready quickly.
* Act as a **world-class teacher**: quickly learn complex topics—AI-moderated research, research methodology, new products, pricing, competitors—then synthesize and deliver them so they stick.
* Own and maintain the **GTM knowledge repository**, keeping messaging, battlecards, playbooks, and product content accurate, organized, and easy to find.
* Partner with **Product and Marketing** to translate launches and roadmap updates into field-ready training, talk tracks, and assets.
* Partner with **Sales, CS, and Partnerships leaders** to identify skill and knowledge gaps and prioritize what gets built next.
* Work with **G&A and Leadership** on cross-functional topics—deal desk, pricing, legal, and process changes—so the field knows what changed and how to act on it.
* Run **live trainings, workshops, and certifications**, and build async content (recordings, guides, quizzes) that scales across time zones.
* Measure what works: track **ramp time, certification completion, content usage, and field feedback**, and iterate on programs accordingly.
* Bring structure to ambiguity—spot gaps no one owns and **find a way to make it work**.

**Qualifications**

* **4+ years of professional experience** in Enablement, Learning & Development, a Center of Excellence, or a Chief of Staff function.
* **Proven program ownership:** you’ve built and run programs end to end, not just contributed to them.
* **Exceptional teaching and communication skills**. You can take a complex topic, distill it, and make it land with any audience.
* You **drive adoption, not just delivery.** You treat sales as your core customer, find the early adopters, and turn their wins into peer examples and success stories that pull the rest of the team along.
* **You build learning that compounds**. You reinforce and build on what reps already know, rather than publishing materials and expecting people to “get it.”
* A track record of designing **scalable, repeatable processes** and systems that others can use without you in the room.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with experience owning a knowledge base, content library, or similar source of truth.
* Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with experience working across GTM, Product, G&A, and senior leadership.
* **Proven success in a fast-paced startup environment.** You’re comfortable with ambiguity, create structure where none exists, and adjust quickly as priorities shift.
* A high-ownership, resourceful mindset: you find a way to make it work.
* Experience supporting B2B SaaS GTM teams is a strong plus; familiarity with AI products or market research is a bonus.

Compensation Range: $130K - $175K

jobs.title: EHS Program Leader, Hazardous Materials & Industrial Safety
jobs.description:

=======================================================

If you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and planet, this role is for you. As our EHS Program Leader for the California R&D/production site, you’ll partner with operations and engineering to design systems that meet regulatory obligations, minimize risk, and advance the business.

----------------

Elevate safety culture while delivering regulatory confidence and operational results.

jobs.title: Compensation Programs & Operations Lead

**About the Team**

OpenAI’s Compensation team helps attract, reward, and retain the people advancing our mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We develop compensation strategies and programs that support a rapidly evolving business, combining market insight, sound judgment, and thoughtful execution. We partner across People, Finance, Legal, and the business to deliver programs that employees and leaders can understand and trust.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Compensation Programs & Operations Lead to own the end-to-end program management of our cyclical and ad hoc compensation programs globally. You will turn compensation priorities into executable plans and lead delivery from initial scoping through launch, reconciliation, and continuous improvement.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a compensation subject-matter expert who is energized by operations and E2E program ownership. You should bring experience across compensation operations analysis, compensation analysis, business partnership, and program management. Having done this work yourself, you understand the practical details behind compensation decisions and what it takes to implement them accurately.

You will establish how our compensation programs run: the calendar, responsibilities, systems requirements, controls, communications, and handoffs that connect program design to the employee experience. You’ll partner closely with Compensation Partners, HR Business Partners, People Operations, People Technology, Finance, Payroll, Equity Administration, and Legal, creating clarity and driving execution as priorities evolve.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Lead our compensation program portfolio.** Own the integrated roadmap and calendar for cyclical and ad hoc programs, including compensation reviews, bonus and equity cycles, promotion-related compensation processes, recognition and retention initiatives, and new program launches.
* **Drive programs from planning through completion.** Define scope, deliverables, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, and resource needs. Coordinate work across teams, resolve blockers, and bring decisions and tradeoffs to the right owners early.
* **Translate compensation expertise into practical operations.** Work with Compensation Partners and program owners to turn approved designs into clear eligibility rules, calculations, workflows, approval paths, and exception processes. Identify gaps and implementation risks before launch.
* **Stay close to the analysis and data.** Build and review models, validate inputs and calculations, investigate discrepancies, and reconcile final outcomes. Be comfortable working directly in the details when a program needs it.
* **Build reliable execution controls.** Establish quality checks, documented approvals, access controls, and audit trails. Coordinate accurate handoffs to Payroll, Equity Administration, and People Operations, with clear ownership through completion.

-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Program Manager on Anthropic's Safeguards team, you'll help make sure we meet our obligations under AI safety laws and regulations around the world. Working closely with Legal, you'll turn new and emerging requirements into programs, controls, and deliverables. This requires a detailed understanding of how our models and products are built, evaluated and safeguarded. Your work will support Anthropic's commitment to developing AI safely and beneficially as the regulatory landscape evolves.

***The responsibilities listed below are some examples of areas that someone in this role could own, depending on their experience and the team's needs.***

jobs.title: Materials and Product Lifecycle Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**

Gimlet is building the first multi-silicon neocloud designed for fast, efficient AI inference.

We combine large-scale compute infrastructure with an execution platform that partitions AI workloads and maps each stage to the hardware best suited to run it.

We work with foundation labs, hyperscalers, and AI-native companies, giving our team access to technical problems spanning frontier models, production infrastructure, and emerging hardware.

**About the role**

As the Product Lifecycle & BOM Operations Program Manager at Gimlet, you will own the lifecycle of the hardware we procure and deploy across our data centers, from new part introduction to end of life. You will create and control internal part numbers, structure top-level assembly BOMs, keep part and BOM data accurate, and translate deployment plans into material requirements.

This role is the operational bridge between Engineering, Supply Chain, and infrastructure deployment. Your focus is making sure we have the right hardware, at the right revision, at the right time.

**What you'll do:**

**Product lifecycle management**

* Own the full part lifecycle: new part introduction, active production, end of life (EOL), and obsolescence.
* Monitor manufacturer EOL notices and product change notifications (PCNs), assess their impact on active and planned deployments, and drive last-time buys or qualified replacements with Engineering.
* Manage excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory, including disposition plans that minimize cost.

**Internal part numbering and part data**

* Create internal part numbers using a consistent numbering scheme, and map each one to its manufacturer part numbers (MPNs) and approved sources.
* Define and enforce part data standards: descriptions, units of measure, revision levels, lifecycle status, and approved manufacturer and vendor lists (AML/AVL).
* Read and interpret component datasheets and spec sheets to verify key attributes, such as form factor, electrical and thermal ratings, compatibility, and compliance, before a part is released.

**BOM structure and accuracy**

* Build and maintain multi-level BOMs, from top-level assemblies (racks, servers, networking) down to sub-assemblies and components.
* Own BOM accuracy: audit BOMs regularly, reconcile them against what is purchased, received, and deployed, and resolve discrepancies quickly.
* Control BOM releases and revisions through the engineering change process (ECR/ECO), and assess each change's impact on open orders, inventory, cost, and delivery.

**Material planning**

* Translate approved deployment plans into time-phased material requirements and purchasing priorities.
* Track long-lead components, shortages, and material readiness across suppliers and sites.
* Report material risks and recommended actions to Supply Chain and deployment leaders.

**What success looks like**

In your first 3 to 6 months, you will:

* Stand up a controlled internal part numbering scheme and part register covering all active deployments.
* Build released, revision-controlled top-level assembly BOMs for our core rack, server, and networking configurations.
* Set a BOM accuracy baseline and a regular audit process, with a clear target and a plan to close the gaps.
* Put an EOL and PCN monitoring process in place for critical components, with last-time-buy or replacement plans for at-risk parts.
* Define clear handoffs with Engineering for BOM releases and engineering changes.
* Build a material-readiness view tied to deployment milestones and purchasing priorities.
* Develop practical PLM and ERP workflows so Engineering, Supply Chain, and deployment teams work from one accurate, current source of part and BOM data.

**You may be a good fit if you have**

* 5+ years of experience in product lifecycle management, BOM management, materials planning, or hardware operations.
* Hands-on experience creating internal part numbers and structuring multi-level BOMs, from top-level assemblies down to components.
* A strong understanding of revision control, engineering change processes (ECR/ECO), and AML/AVL management.
* The ability to read and interpret datasheets and spec sheets for hardware such as servers, networking gear, power, cabling, and optics.
* Experience managing EOL notices, PCNs, last-time buys, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Experience translating changing deployment schedules into material plans, and managing long-lead components and shortages.
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced spreadsheet experience and hands-on use of PLM systems (such as Arena, Agile, or Windchill) and ERP systems (such as NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle).
* The ability to work closely with Engineering while respecting clear ownership: Engineering owns design, technical qualification, and substitutions; you own part data and BOM integrity.
* A track record of bringing structure and discipline to fast-moving hardware programs.

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience supporting data center, compute, networking, server, semiconductor, or other complex hardware deployments.
* Experience building a part numbering system, BOM standards, or PLM process from scratch in a fast-scaling company.
* Experience implementing, migrating, or improving PLM and ERP systems.
* Experience working across multiple suppliers, contract manufacturers or ODMs, deployment sites, and hardware configurations.
* An APICS/ASCM certification such as CPIM or CSCP.

**Why join now?**

Gimlet is expanding from its core technology into a production neocloud spanning new hardware, customers, and data centers.

* Solve hard problems.
* Own meaningful work.
* Build for production.
* Help define what’s next.

*Agency Policy:* *Gimlet Labs does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without a signed agreement will be considered the property of Gimlet Labs, and no fees will be paid.*

jobs.description:
**About Factory**
-----------------

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.  
  
We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

------------------

Factory is pioneering autonomous software development. At the heart of this mission is our GTM organization, where we are rapidly scaling a world-class sales team to bring innovative developer tools to market.

We are seeking a visionary Sales Enablement Manager to architect, lead, and independently scale our end-to-end onboarding and certification strategy. In this foundational role, you will design the strategic playbook for selling Factory from the ground up, shaping how every new seller achieves consistent productivity.

Partnering closely with leaders and teams across Factory, you will define our sales methodology and build programs that turn technical innovations into enterprise adoption. If you thrive in an early-stage environment where you can autonomously own strategic initiatives and accelerate the future of software engineering, this is your opportunity to make a defining impact.

### **What you will do and achieve**

Program Strategy & Architecture

* Drive strategy and end-to-end execution for onboarding every new seller at Factory, from day one to their first closed deal.
* Independently build and scale the program by designing the strategic playbook for selling Factory where no prior template exists.
* Shape how new sellers sell at Factory, since every one of them starts in your program.

Bootcamp & Role-Based Certification

* Design and maintain comprehensive curriculum tracks for Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, and Sales Development Representatives, covering foundational company knowledge before diving into role-specific workflows.
* Lead interactive live training sessions for bootcamp cohorts, partnering closely with subject matter experts, moderators, and sales leaders to facilitate continuous learning.
* Establish clear evaluation criteria and certification standards for each role, holding new hires accountable and continuously refining content based on cohort performance and feedback.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management

* Partner with managers to establish and track 90-day onboarding plans, stepping in to support new hires who fall behind.

Scalability, Delivery & AI Integration

* Package and scale training modules so sessions can be delivered seamlessly by managers and senior reps, supporting both local and remote sellers via live and self-paced learning.
* Maintain curriculum currency and relevance by continuously updating content as the product evolves and retiring obsolete materials.
* Leverage AI agents and automated workflows (such as Droids) to streamline program administration, update materials, and track seller readiness efficiently.

Continuous Learning & Performance Measurement

* Train experienced reps too, with launch updates, sales method refreshers at QBRs and Sales Kickoff, and focused help where we are losing deals.

------------------

* Enablement Experience & Leadership: 5+ years in sales enablement focused on building, driving, and scaling end-to-end new-hire onboarding strategies from scratch.
* Instructional Design & Presentation: Deep expertise in instructional design principles, creating clear and attractive training collateral, and delivering engaging live presentations in person or virtually.
* Metrics & Execution: Highly organized and detail-oriented with a proven track record of tracking ramp metrics and optimizing enablement programs based on performance data.

**About the job**
-----------------

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As an Account Manager Associate, you will be part of the Google Americas sales associate program. Through this program, Google develops sales associates in specific product and business training and executive access/exposure over a fixed period of time. You will move across different Google advertising sales teams and roles, serving as media account managers for short-term assignments to help cover team member extended leaves. Upon completion of the program, you will transition into permanent account manager roles or other positions at Google. You will work in a team-focused environment, managing relationships with clients, and work with your manager to find a permanent role post program.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**What we do and why we do it**

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

**How it's going (and growing)**

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of **Stessa** (financial and asset management software), **RentPrep** (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and **Mynd** (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in **Casago** (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

**About the Role**

Roofstock is looking to hire an organized, systems-minded, and experienced Senior Legal Operations Manager to join our Legal team. This individual will own how legal work moves through the business: how it comes in, how it gets tracked, how it gets executed, and how it gets approved and paid. The Senior Legal Operations Manager will build durable workflows in place of institutional memory, keep contract turnaround predictable, maintain clean and complete records, support claims and litigation management in-house, and help manage outside counsel spend against budget. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad visibility, partnering closely with Finance, People Operations, Compliance, and the business teams that depend on Legal to move quickly.

### **Responsibilities**

**Legal Operations & Contract Management**

* Contract Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end contract intake, routing, workflow optimization, and status tracking using Zip.
* First-Line Agreement Review: Perform initial triage and review of incoming third-party agreements in Zip, evaluating red flags, indemnification terms, and standard boilerplate before escalating complex issues to attorneys.
* Process & Self-Service Optimization: Build and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and self-service tools to empower business teams and eliminate attorney bottlenecks on routine agreements.
* Repository & Record Management: Establish repository standards (e.g., Google Drive structure) and manage post-execution filing and signature routing so critical legal records remain organized, current, and accessible.

**Financial Management & Outside Counsel Operations**

* Spend Management & Billing: Oversee law firm billing guidelines, manage outside counsel engagements, and perform initial invoice reviews.
* Finance & Accounting Alignment: Track legal spend against department budgets and collaborate directly with Accounting and Finance on monthly accruals, reporting, and operational friction points.
* Vendor Negotiations: Support rate negotiations with outside counsel and evaluate third-party legal vendors.

**Corporate Governance, Transactions & Claims (Paralegal Support)**

* Entity Management & Cap Table: Manage corporate governance, state filings, annual reports, and registered agent coordination across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Maintain cap table and corporate records in Carta.
* Transaction Support: Coordinate document collection, diligence request tracking, and virtual data room administration (e.g., DataSite) for corporate transactions and financings.
* Litigation & Claims Support: Support in-house claims and litigation intake, issue litigation holds, corporate insurance, coordinate document collection, track deadlines, and liaise with outside litigation counsel.

**Legal Technology & Department Analytics**

* System Administration: Directly administer legal tooling, including Zip (CLM), Carta, e-signature tools, and billing software.
* Reporting & Metrics: Build and maintain operational dashboards that track legal work volume, spend trends, and process bottlenecks for leadership.
* AI & Automation: Identify and implement emerging AI tools and automation to reduce manual workflows while maintaining appropriate review protocols.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of total experience in legal operations, contract management, or paralegal roles, with a strong core background (3+ years) in corporate paralegal responsibilities.
* Experience in a high-growth, late-stage private company (Series B/C/E) or proptech/fintech/real estate environment preferred (public company experience is not required).
* Solid working understanding of key contract terms (indemnification, liability, boilerplate provisions), corporate entity management across multiple jurisdictions, and litigation hold procedures.
* Practical experience with litigation and claims management, including handling matter intake, issuing litigation holds, managing discovery/document collection, tracking critical deadlines, and coordinating with outside litigation counsel.
* Proven ability to partner across business functions, particularly Finance, Accounting, and Human Resources to streamline operational pain points.
* Adaptable "jack-of-all-trades" mindset and self-starter with strong ownership, high discretion, and a natural instinct to systematize and document processes.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
* Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel
* Preferred practical exposure to Zip (CLM), Carta (cap table/entity management), DataSite (VDR), Serengeti/Tracker, or Ironclad
* High degree of ownership, attention to detail, and bias toward action
* Curiosity and willingness to use AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency while maintaining proper validation and judgment
* Real estate, proptech, fintech, or other regulated-industry experience preferred

San Francisco, CA | Monday–Friday, 25 hours/week during the school year and 40 hours/week during summer | Part-time (school year), Full-time (summer)| $24–$25/hr | Benefits Eligible

##### **Why This Role Matters**

Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character and community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a School-Based Club team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

##### **What You’ll Do**

Program Leaders are assigned to a Clubhouse department based on their knowledge and expertise, where they design and lead tailored programs, coordinate and supervise field trips, and independently oversee day-to-day department operations. You’ll play a direct role in shaping the lives of youth in our community, and the position is a stepping stone into Clubhouse leadership.

* Keep members safe — Provide a safe, nurturing environment for every youth in your program.
* Facilitate engaging programs — Create and lead after-school programs and activities for a group of approximately ten members.
* Plan purposeful lessons — Develop age-appropriate lesson plans and activities that promote personal growth, educational achievement, and character development.
* Mentor youth — Serve as a positive role model and mentor, building members’ self-esteem and personal development.
* Cultivate Clubhouse culture — Set standards and expectations grounded in mutual respect between staff and the community we serve.
* Lead field trips — Coordinate and supervise department field trips from planning through return.
* Collaborate with the team — Work alongside junior-level colleagues to meet program goals and share best practices.

##### **What You Bring**

###### **Required**

* Minimum two years of youth development experience working with youth ages 6 to 18 in a youth development setting
* Ability to build strong relationships with youth and create engaging curriculum
* Strong positive discipline skills, with the ability to manage youth behavior and maintain high expectations
* Proven communication, organizational, and self-starter skills
* Strong ability to create and follow systems and procedures in a fast-paced environment with continual distractions

###### **Preferred**

* Education or coursework in Early Childhood Development, Education, or a related field
* Current Red Cross First Aid/CPR certification (or willing to obtain within 90 days of employment)
* Proven leadership or mentorship experience

* Must be able to lift 25 lbs.

**About Factory**
-----------------

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.  
  
We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.  
  
In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

**About the Role**
------------------

As our Technical Enablement Manager, you will build technical enablement at Factory from the ground up as one of the first hires on the GTM Enablement team. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Sales leadership to drive technical excellence across the entire customer lifecycle.

You will embed yourself within Engineering, Product, and Marketing to translate technical direction and product positioning into actionable GTM guidance. By setting a high technical bar for customer-facing teams, you will empower sellers to engage confidently with engineering leaders and equip Solutions Engineers and Deployment teams with program playbooks, enablement assets, effective demos, and rollout strategies.

### **What you will do and achieve**

* Embed Upstream & Downstream: Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Marketing as a peer to translate technical direction into actionable guidance for our Sales, Solutions Engineering and Deployment teams.
* Align Product Rollouts & Marketing with GTM: Design efficient enablement motions and partner with Marketing to produce enablement assets and keep sales and post-sale teams aligned on positioning, messaging, and target personas.
* Set Technical Bar & Voice: Establish high technical standards for customer-facing teams and act as the technical voice of GTM back to Product and Engineering.
* Drive Solutions Engineering Enablement: Own onboarding and ongoing enablement for SEs, covering effective demos, value-driven scoping, POVs, and post-sale technical success.
* Streamline Customer Deployments: Equip deployment teams with the playbooks and technical strategies needed to accelerate enterprise rollouts and time-to-value.
* Scale Post-Sale Adoption Playbooks: Build hackathon and onboarding frameworks that ensure deep, sticky usage of Droids across customer engineering organizations.
* Serve as a Trusted Developer Advocate: Build with Droids daily to credibly demonstrate capabilities and earn the trust of enterprise engineering leaders and developers.

*Can you turn a business growth goal into a resource plan, then lead the team that delivers it?*

*Can you resolve today’s scheduling problem while building the capacity to prevent the next one?*

*Are you a leader…….that personally executes while “being in the mix”?*

CRC Salomon is hiring a **Client Operations Manager, Court Reporting** to lead client scheduling and court reporter resource operations. Reporting directly to Robert Deziel, Chief Operating Officer, you will partner with him on business planning and own departmental execution. That means anticipating demand, developing the team, protecting service quality, and building the resource capacity to support profitable growth.

You must be able to perform both scheduling functions yourself, coach others to do them well, and make sound decisions when client needs, resource availability, and deadlines compete. You are a people leader, driving a team located both locally and remotely throughout the U.S. and internationally.

**To Apply**

Email the following to **Shannon Linville, Hiring Manager**, at **slinville@crcsalomon.com**:

* Your resume and LinkedIn Profile (if you have one)
* A brief video recording answering: **“Why do you believe you would be a strong fit for the Client Operations Manager, Court Reporting role at CRC Salomon?”**

Use any recording method you prefer. Attach the recording or include a link, and confirm that we can access it.

**Email subject:** Client Operations Manager, Court Reporting | Your Name

**About CRC Salomon**

Founded in 1898, CRC Salomon is one of the nation’s first court reporting companies. We serve law firms, courts, government agencies, and businesses through court reporting, transcription, legal video, and remote proceedings. We are strengthening leadership over client scheduling and resource operations to support growth while maintaining the accuracy and dependability our clients expect.

**What you will do**

* **Partner with the COO:** Translate business priorities into operating plans with clear owners and milestones. Bring data, recommendations, progress updates, and specific roadblocks to leadership discussions, then carry agreed decisions through to completion.
* **Lead the department:** Set priorities across client scheduling and resource management. Coach performance, delegate effectively, develop team capability, and hold people accountable for service and execution. Participate in hiring and onboarding.
* **Own client scheduling:** Oversee requests from intake through confirmation and follow-through. Ensure proceeding details, time zones, locations or virtual platforms, client preferences, service requirements, and changes are captured accurately in ReporterBase/RB9.
* **Secure qualified coverage:** Match court reporters, videographers, interpreters, and other resources to assignments based on qualifications, jurisdiction, availability, location, client needs, and cost. Review upcoming work, arrange backups, and resolve gaps before the proceeding.
* **Forecast and recruit ahead:** Connect sales plans and market expansion to staffing and contractor needs over the coming weeks and months. Lead resource recruiting, onboarding, and retention, build reporter relationships, and participate in rate discussions within approved guidelines.
* **Handle escalations and provide coverage:** Lead resolution of client and reporter issues, cancellations, and urgent changes. Communicate clearly until the issue is resolved. Personally handle scheduling or resource assignments when coverage or team development requires it.
* **Coordinate across departments:** Work with Production, Billing, Sales, and case management to ensure accurate job instructions, transcript orders, delivery requirements, and handoffs. Resolve ownership gaps and keep commitments visible.
* **Improve systems and workflows:** Strengthen RB9 use, shared-inbox management, data quality, procedures, and training. Apply practical technology and AI tools where they improve work while protecting accuracy and confidentiality.
* **Manage measurable performance:** Track response and confirmation times, assignment coverage, scheduling accuracy, recruiting progress, resource capacity, and cost. Identify trends, implement corrective action, and report how the department is supporting service, growth, and profitability.

**What we are looking for**

* **People leadership:** Demonstrated success setting expectations, coaching employees, delegating work, and improving team performance. You can point to results delivered through others.
* **Relevant operating experience:** Court reporting or litigation support experience is strongly preferred. We will consider legal-services professionals, including paralegals or legal assistants with substantive leadership experience, and staffing/recruiting operations leaders who demonstrate transferable judgment.
* **Scheduling and resource judgment:** Experience coordinating time-sensitive work, managing competing requirements, and resolving service disruptions. You understand what dependable support means to attorneys and other professional clients.
* **Business ownership:** You connect daily decisions to capacity, cost, client retention, and growth. You turn goals into practical plans and follow through without needing each step prescribed.
* **Credibility and constructive challenge:** You build trust with experienced staff and independent professionals, explain your recommendations clearly, welcome direct feedback, and challenge assumptions with evidence.
* **Technical capability:** Comfort with Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint, plus scheduling or resource-management systems. ReporterBase/RB9 experience is preferred. You use data to make decisions and can evaluate practical uses of AI and automation.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.  
.

**Hiring and how we work**

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.  
.

**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategy & Operations Manager.

**About the job**

This position will be responsible for unlocking exceptional growth for Twilio’s customers and business.

We are seeking a high-achieving individual to join Twilio’s Strategic Growth team in the Industry Relations & Strategic Growth organization. In this high-visibility role, you will tackle executive-level strategic problems that have no straightforward answers while moving quickly to keep pace with the fast-moving communications and AI ecosystem. You will unlock new customer use cases, improve the quality of our global telecommunications network, and drive profitability. You will do this by defining complex problems and solving them through first-principles thinking, data analysis, storytelling, interviews, and collaborative cross-functional relationships. You will be an owner of strategic projects with significant autonomy, and will engage with senior executives to present your recommendations and accelerate decisions.

You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact in product-led growth, international expansion, compliance, and go-to-market. If you have an extreme owner / founder mindset, move fast, and want to solve big challenges in a rapidly growing space, you’ll find yourself at home.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* Strategic Decision-Making: Partner with executive leadership to define, model, and execute high-impact business strategies across messaging, voice, and AI communications ecosystems.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Drive end-to-end alignment across Carrier Relations, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, and GTM teams to achieve core company goals.
* End-to-End Ownership: Take full accountability for VP-level strategic goals, delivering mission-critical projects on schedule while optimizing customer experience.
* Executive Communication: Synthesize complex technical and strategic data into concise executive presentations, strategic memos, and board-level reporting.
* Data-Driven Modeling: Perform data analysis and build quantitative models to solve complex, unstructured business challenges under tight timelines.
* Domain Expert: Lead as the Subject Matter Expert for global connectivity initiatives, advising executive leadership and driving results across reach, quality, and profitability. Prior expertise isn't required to apply – just a commitment to learn.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

* **Required:**

* 4-6 years of experience in strategy, operations, management consulting, product, or growth roles.
* Exceptional ability to synthesize complex technical, operational, and financial data into concise written memos and executive presentations that drive rapid decision-making.
* Proven ability to build relationships and drive alignment across Product, Sales, Operations, and Finance across individual contributors to VP levels.
* Proven ability to think critically and apply structured problem-solving techniques to unfamiliar challenges.
* Strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization e.g., SQL, Looker, Tableau, Coefficient, Airtable.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

**Desired:**

* Experience in SaaS, technology, management consulting, banking, or other fast-paced environments.
* Experience using AI to accelerate productivity e.g. Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Glean.
* Familiarity with telecom, messaging, and voice networks.

**Location**

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

**Travel**

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

**What We Offer**

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

JOB TITLE Operations Manager – Remote Tax & Advisory Firm (Path to COO)

COMPANY Physicians Financial Advisory LOCATION

Remote (US) PAY $60,500 – $82,500 per year, plus quarterly bonus (up to 15% of base) and equity path JOB TYPE Full-time

ABOUT US Physicians Financial Advisory is a $800,000 tax and advisory firm serving physicians, nurse practitioners and medical practice owners. Credentialed CPAs and Enrolled Agents deliver our tax work through a remote team. We are growing through marketing and acquisition, and we need the person who makes the firm run. THE ROLE You will own operations end to end and take over day-to-day management from our founder. This is not an assistant role. Hit clearly defined milestones and the COO title, with an equity interest, follows by the end of 2028.

WHAT YOU'LL DO - Manage workflow, deadlines and capacity across our outsourced tax preparers - Run our client portal and practice-management platform (migration starting this winter) - Build and maintain our library of standard operating procedures - Own a weekly scorecard: jobs on time, work in progress, client response time - Handle client escalations so they never need to reach the founder - Hire, onboard and manage client advisors as we grow - Integrate client books from practices we acquire - Enforce our data-security and AI-use policies

WHAT YOU BRING - 3+ years running operations or workflow at an accounting, tax, financial advisory or professional services firm - Experience managing remote or outsourced teams against hard deadlines (a tax season counts) - SOPs you've written that other people actually follow - Comfort with numbers: you track metrics weekly and act on them - Daily use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how to protect client data while using them - Calm, clear communication with demanding, high-income clients - Must have: EA, CPA, or tax preparation experience; TaxDome, Canopy or Karbon experience

WHAT WE OFFER - $60,500 – $82,500 base salary - Quarterly bonus of up to 15% of base, tied to the scorecard you own - Phantom equity that converts to real equity at COO promotion - 100% remote - A founder whose stated goal is to make himself unnecessary.

HOW TO APPLY- Apply with your resume and a short answer to this question: Describe a process you documented that ran without you. What broke first, and how did you fix it? Our process includes a short take-home work sample and reference calls with former managers.

Pay: $60,500.00 - $82,600.00 per year

Experience:

* Tax accounting: 2 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* Enrolled Agent (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

Lawelawe is a Native Hawaiian Owned Small Disadvantaged Business that provides professional and mission-support services to federal Government customers. We are committed to delivering dependable solutions, supporting our employees, and advancing our mission to uplift economically disadvantaged Native Hawaiian families and preserve Native Hawaiian heritage.

### **You Are**

An experienced technical leader who can manage software development, guide teams, and keep daily program operations moving forward. You bring sound judgment, strong communication skills, and the ability to translate complex requirements into clear priorities and achievable results. You are comfortable representing Lawelawe with Government customers, corporate leadership, and subcontractors while providing direction and accountability to assigned employees.

### **How You Will Make an Impact**

As the Technical Deputy Program Manager, serving as the Program Manager’s principal deputy and Lawelawe’s senior representative on the contract. Reporting to and supporting the Program Manager, you will guide technical resources, oversee software development from initial design through release, and coordinate Lawelawe personnel and subcontractor support. During planned or unplanned Program Manager absences, you will assume delegated authority for daily program operations to maintain continuity, customer support, and timely delivery.

### **Responsibilities**

* Support the Program Manager in directing daily contract operations, coordinating resources, and meeting program objectives.
* Serve as acting Program Manager during planned or unplanned absences, exercising delegated authority to maintain operations, customer support, and required deliverables.
* Serve as the senior representative and the primary link between Lawelawe corporate leadership and the program team.
* Represent Lawelawe; coordinate subcontractor activities, monitor assigned performance, and resolve or escalate staffing and execution issues through established contract channels.
* Supervise assigned Lawelawe and Program Management Office (PMO) employees, including workload assignments, performance reviews, coaching, and employee development.
* Coordinate hiring activities with Talent Acquisition and address employee relations and corrective actions in coordination with HR.
* Guide daily execution across software engineering, development operations, cybersecurity, systems integration, and other applicable technical workstreams.
* Translate contractual requirements and agency objectives into technical priorities, requirements, specifications, and executable workflows.
* Manage software development projects from design through completion, including analysis, design, development of enhancements and new modules, testing, evaluation, and release.
* Partner with the Program Manager and Product Owners to define product strategy, forecast development needs, and plan and execute the product roadmap.
* Research product development options and recommend technical approaches and product direction.
* Facilitate Agile/Scrum ceremonies and technical governance reviews, providing teams with clear direction, resources, and realistic schedule and cost estimates.
* Coordinate deployment of functional improvements within approved release schedules and promote continuous technical improvement.
* Partner with the Program Manager to manage scope, schedule, resources, and cost baselines and track performance against contract requirements.
* Identify program risks, operational bottlenecks, and engineering issues; implement corrective actions and escalate matters requiring additional authority.
* Work with the Program Director, Program Manager, customer, technical leads, and program staff to meet staffing and performance needs.
* Coordinate with Government stakeholders, corporate leadership, subcontractors, and program teams to align priorities and resolve technical and operational issues.
* Prepare program reports, deliverables, executive briefings, and written updates that clearly communicate technical metrics, progress, risks, and decisions needed.

### **The Team**

Our team brings together program management and technical professionals who work collaboratively to support customer priorities. You will partner with program leadership, development teams, corporate support functions, and subcontractors to deliver reliable solutions and maintain consistent program performance.

### **Here's What You Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* At least seven (7) years of experience in software product design, development, release, and delivery, including at least five (5) years of management or leadership experience within a software development organization and at least two (2) years managing a Scrum team.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a program’s second in charge and assume daily program leadership during the Program Manager’s absence.
* Ability to serve as senior contract representative, lead assigned employees, coordinate subcontractor support, and communicate with Government and corporate leadership.
* Experience with risk management, issue resolution, and problem-solving.
* Knowledge of system architectures, networks, and operations.
* United States citizenship and ability to provide proof of citizenship.
* Ability to successfully complete required background screening and satisfy applicable Government suitability requirements to obtain a Public Trust.

### **Additional Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical information to internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-resolution skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and provide strategic direction.
* Ability to anticipate and respond proactively to technical and operational challenges.
* Experience applying Agile principles and Scru

**Location:** Sidoarjo or Malang District, East Java, Indonesia, with regular support to program operations with our implementing partners in Bogor and Depok (West Java)
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
  
The TUNTAS Program Manager is the senior operational lead for the TUNTAS program. The role sets strategic direction, ensures technical quality, and makes sure program investments draw on Indonesia’s wider education system and donor landscape.
  
The role leads the design and delivery of an integrated package of technical assistance to district and provincial governments. The program aims to reduce school dropout and improve educational outcomes for vulnerable children and young people. It does this by strengthening access to inclusive, quality, and relevant learning through youth empowerment, school and community engagement, and sustainable education systems. It covers four districts in the two provinces with the highest concentration of dropout risk: Bogor and Depok (West Java), and Sidoarjo and Malang (East Java).
  
The role keeps the TUNTAS program design consistent and connected with other Save the Children initiatives in Indonesia, and aligned with the DBS Foundation, to maximize impact and support lasting system change. The position requires deep expertise in the Indonesian education system, both formal and non-formal. It also requires proven experience delivering large-scale capacity building at the local level and a strong grounding in adult learning and systems-strengthening approaches.
  
**KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY**
  
**Technical Leadership and Program Quality**

* Lead the overall implementation of the TUNTAS program across target locations, in line with the approved program design, donor commitments, national education priorities, and Save the Children’s policies and quality standards.
* Under the direction of the Head of Children Development, provide operational leadership, strategic implementation planning, and coordination across program components and locations.
* Work closely with the Education Technical Advisor and relevant technical specialists so that education interventions are technically sound, contextually appropriate, inclusive, and consistently implemented.
* Integrate life skills, dropout prevention, education continuity, and re-engagement pathways into one coherent program approach.
* Systematically integrate Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), climate change, child protection, and child participation into program design and implementation.
* Adjust work plans based on field data and monitoring results, resolve implementation issues quickly, and follow up on stakeholder feedback.

**Oversight and Management of Project Implementation**

* Coordinate the overall project, working closely with direct reports, local implementing partners, and stakeholders to deliver a high-quality program.
* Develop a Detailed Implementation Plan for all program areas. Ensure on-time delivery that meets the quality framework and standards, including monitoring and evaluation, and that program approaches work together.
* Ensure adherence to good programming guidelines, including international good practice.
* Raise any implementation issues with the line manager, with recommendations for resolution.
* Work with the Program Impact & Policy Department to maintain program quality framework standards and identify opportunities for scaling up work in project areas.
* Coordinate external technical assistance visits from Jakarta-based and international staff, as well as the donor.
* Ensure timely and accurate narrative and financial reporting to the National Office and Save the Children Members.
* Maintain a green rating on program KPIs, as reviewed monthly by Save the Children.

**Financial Management**

* Develop program budgets and projections with the program and Finance teams.
* Ensure effective and efficient use of project resources.
* Regularly monitor budget vs. actual expenditure and proactively propose changes to expenditure plans and projections.
* Apply appropriate controls to project resources, including accurate tracking of all expenditure and financial management and tracking for implementing partners.
* Coordinate with the Finance unit to produce accurate and timely financial reports.
* Review financial reports to confirm they match project activities.

**Partnership Management, Eco-Convener and Localization**

* Manage program implementation through local partners, applying the localization roadmap across its seven dimensions.
* Secure the resources needed for program success, in line with Save the Children and donor standards.
* Support the growth of SC Indonesia’s portfolio through staff capacity building, partnership and network development, and new funding opportunities. Provide evidence-based, strategic input to proposal development, drawing on learning and evaluation from ongoing projects and regular assessment and research with relevant departments.
* Provide input on Save the Children Indonesia’s strategic initiatives and innovations within its transformation journey, mainly eco-convener, localization, and integrated programming with regional development.
* Strengthen strategic partnerships with the Partnerships unit to increase the reach and impact of Save the Children Indonesia’s mission.
* Work closely with the Awards, PIC, Partnerships, Finance, Supply Chain, and field implementation teams on partner assessment, transparent selection, and capacity building, in line with SC Partnership Principles.
* Directly manage relationships with partners that implement in more than one Save the Children Indonesia area. Ensure good coordination between these partners and the area and field offices.
* Support the National Office in conducting partner capacity assessments and capacity-strengthening plans within the area of supervision.
