jobs.title: Hardware Deployment Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Gather AI**  
Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery.  
If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.  
**About the Team**  
Gather AI's Hardware team designs, builds and supports the hardware behind our platform: autonomous inventory drones and camera systems that mount on customers' material handling equipment (MHE). The team includes hardware engineers and technicians who work out of the Pittsburgh HQ. Hardware designs and builds new product implementations, reviews and repairs RMAs, and performs detailed analysis of field failures while Field Ops runs day-to-day customer site support.  
**About the role**  
Our robots are already working in customer warehouses, and every new deployment depends on the right hardware arriving built, configured and ready. In this role, you'll own the hardware side of that: deployment readiness, field hardware escalations and returns, and accurate documentation of deployment configurations and bill of materials (BOMs) across Hardware programs. This is an ownership role and much of the processes behind it are yours to build collaboratively with Hardware leadership. As our Hardware Deployment & Development Coordinator, you'll be the hardware team's hub between development and field operations: making sure each deployment's hardware is ready on time, owning how we handle field hardware issues and returns, and keeping our bills of materials and fleet configurations accurate across all our hardware programs. You'll report to our Director of Hardware and work closely with engineers, technicians, Field Ops, Purchasing and customer implementation teams.  
**What you'll do**

* Own hardware readiness for each customer deployment: build schedules, kit lists, parts status, shipping and site prerequisites.
* Be on site for installs and go-lives as the hardware liaison lead, then hand off cleanly to Field Ops.
* Own tier-2 hardware escalations: triage, route to the right technician or engineer, and close the loop.
* Own our RMA process: intake, disposition, failure analysis coordination and trend reporting back to engineering and suppliers.
* Own BOM accuracy and configuration management across programs, including revision control and serial/config traceability.
* Build and document the processes behind the work, including the readiness checklist, RMA workflow and configuration control.
* Plan development builds and test assets with engineering and the technicians, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Coordinate development builds, test assets and technician schedules, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Give Purchasing a clear demand plan and flag long-lead and single-source risks early.

**What you bring**

* You've owned hardware readiness for deployments, production launches or NPI builds end to end —, covering schedules, kits, parts and handoffs — and kept other teams moving toward the date without direct authority.
* You've owned the record of what hardware is built and implemented: BOMs and revisions, configurations and change control, or RMA processes. Ideally you've build one of these, not just owned it.a BOM or configuration record, an inventory system or an RMA process.
* You can read assembly and part drawings, electrical schematics, and understand critical to quality callouts. drawings and harness pinouts, and you're comfortable getting hands-on to troubleshoot hardware.
* You can take a field escalation from first report to resolution and keep everyone informed along the way.
* You're detail-oriented, agile and adaptable and adapt quickly when plans change.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in warehouse, material handling or forklift environments.
* Robotics or autonomous-vehicle deployment experience.
* Experience working with suppliers or contract manufacturers on ECOs or recurring defects.Experience coordinating with suppliers or contract manufacturers.
* Experience with Document Control, Good Documentation Practices, and Good Manufacturing Practices.

**Location** Pittsburgh, PA (on site) or remote in the US. About one week a month on site in Pittsburgh; when a customer deployment is active, travel to that site takes priority. Eastern time zone is a plus.  
**How we hire** A recruiter conversation, a conversation with the hiring manager, a practical deployment-planning exercise, and a final round with the team. We'll tell you before each step whether AI tools are welcome.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Lab Equipment & Casework
jobs.description:
Micro-Cap Solutions is conducting a confidential search on behalf of an established architectural millwork and laboratory casework manufacturer seeking an experienced Project Manager – Lab Equipment & Casework to oversee complex laboratory and scientific casework projects from award through installation and closeout.

Our client specializes in custom manufacturing and installation, including laboratory casework, scientific furniture, and specialized equipment. This position requires a strong understanding of commercial construction, technical coordination, and project execution, with particular emphasis on laboratory environments and Division 11/12 scopes.

The Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for the overall execution and financial performance of assigned laboratory casework and equipment projects, overseeing scheduling, budgeting, procurement, subcontractor coordination, and client communication.

This is a hands-on position requiring close collaboration with General Contractors, Architects, Laboratory Planners, Engineering, Production, and Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) trades.

The ideal candidate understands how laboratory casework and equipment integrate with building systems and can proactively identify coordination issues involving utility rough-ins, equipment installation, and project sequencing.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Management & Execution**

* Manage laboratory casework and scientific equipment projects from award through installation and final closeout
* Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, budgets, and delivery expectations
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify cost, scheduling, and execution risks
* Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, and internal departments to ensure project requirements are met
* Maintain consistent communication with General Contractors and other project stakeholders
* Manage multiple project priorities while maintaining quality and customer satisfaction

**Laboratory Casework & MEP Coordination**

* Coordinate Division 11/12 laboratory casework and equipment scopes with Architects, Laboratory Planners, General Contractors, and MEP trades
* Review architectural drawings, laboratory equipment plans, and coordination drawings
* Coordinate plumbing, electrical, and HVAC requirements for laboratory benches, fume hoods, and built-in equipment
* Identify conflicts involving utility rough-ins, equipment placement, and installation sequencing before they impact the project
* Coordinate fume hood exhaust systems and emergency safety equipment, including eyewash stations and safety showers
* Review laboratory casework shop drawings and submittals for compliance with project specifications and applicable SEFA standards

**Financial Management & Change Orders**

* Monitor project budgets and financial performance throughout execution
* Prepare and negotiate change orders, including pricing and supporting documentation
* Identify value-engineering opportunities and cost-saving solutions
* Complete monthly Cost-to-Complete reporting
* Coordinate with Finance to maintain accurate project financial reporting and ERP information
* Manage project scopes involving annual billings of $5M or more

**Engineering, Procurement & Installation**

* Review project submittals against architectural plans, specifications, and contractual scope
* Verify material takeoffs and ensure timely procurement of required materials
* Coordinate equipment lead times and material availability with project schedules
* Partner with Engineering, Production, and Field Operations to resolve technical and constructability issues
* Ensure subcontractors, suppliers, and installation teams follow approved drawings, specifications, and schedules
* Proactively address field issues to maintain project momentum

**Qualifications**

* **3–4+ years of hands-on field and/or shop experience** within millwork, laboratory casework, scientific furniture, or another construction trade
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, technical specifications, and construction documents
* Basic working knowledge of plumbing, electrical, and HVAC systems as they relate to laboratory casework and equipment
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage competing deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently
* Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Outlook
* Familiarity with SEFA standards and laboratory casework systems preferred
* Prior millwork Project Management or Project Engineering experience is a plus
* Experience with laboratory planning, fume hoods, scientific casework, or epoxy resin countertops is highly desirable
* Working knowledge of Innergy ERP is a plus
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or related trade education preferred
* Familiarity with Lean Construction principles and continuous improvement is beneficial

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Tester (QA / Security / 508) + Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **WE ARE A FEDERAL IT COMPANY ON A MISSION TO MAKE CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE (CX) THE CENTER OF EVERY GOVERNMENT SOLUTION.**

### **TECHNOLOGY IS OUR PASSION. PEOPLE ARE OUR PURPOSE.**

We know tech, but we love people. NuAxis is home to thinkers and feelers; engineers and artists. We work hard and support each other along the way. Teamwork is more than just a buzzword for us, it’s a state of mind.

We believe happy employees do amazing work, so join our team NOW! We are currently seeking a talented and motivated **Tester (QA / Security / 508) + Business Analyst** for a Full-Time position.

### **ROLE SUMMARY**

A hybrid quality assurance and business analysis role on an Agile delivery team modernizing WHD’s legacy .NET applications (Workers Owed Wages, External User Portal, Section 14(c), FLC Online, DirectoryAdmin) to Drupal 10+ on DOL’s PACE containerized AWS platform, and building new public-facing portals for wage determination surveys and online complaint intake. The role owns the path from requirements elicitation to accepted, release-ready functionality, including functional, security, and Section 508 test evidence required for every production release.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Facilitate requirements elicitation with WHD Product Owners, SMEs, and OCIO stakeholders; decompose needs into Jira epics, features, and user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria.
* Document and maintain process flows, use cases, wireframe annotations, and requirements traceability in Jira and Confluence.
* Develop sprint- and release-level test plans, test cases, and test scripts; execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing support.
* Test Drupal Webform-based forms and integrations with Login.gov, WISE/CAPS on Appian, SharePoint, and Kafka, including real-time inline validation, one-time submission rules, bilingual (English/Spanish) content, and audit logging.
* Perform Section 508 / WCAG AA conformance testing using the DHS Trusted Tester methodology and DOL-approved tools (ANDI, NVDA, JAWS, Compliance Sheriff), including keyboard operability and assistive technology compatibility.
* Conduct application security testing in support of DevSecOps and the ATO: validate OWASP Top 10 protections (XSS, CSRF, SQL injection), review scan results, and verify remediation of STIG and SRR findings.
* Support OCIO security test and evaluation activities and assessment teams during system security testing.
* Log, categorize, and trace defects per OCIO categories with full linkage (Roadmap User Story Task Defect); deliver end-to-end defect reports at the close of every test cycle.
* Assemble release-readiness evidence: Section 508, mobile/tablet, security, and functional test reports, with no open in-sprint defects.
* Participate in all Agile/SAFe ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of combined software quality assurance and business analysis experience, including 3+ years in federal Agile/SAFe environments.
* Current DHS Trusted Tester certification (verification of Section 508 knowledge is required for contract personnel).
* Hands-on experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases in Jira and Confluence (Xray, Zephyr, or similar).
* Working knowledge of web application security testing (OWASP Top 10) and NIST SP 800-53 / ATO support activities.
* Experience testing public-facing web portals and forms, including REST API testing with Postman or similar tools.
* Strong written communication and stakeholder facilitation skills.
* U.S. person; must obtain and maintain a favorable NACI / HSPD-12 background investigation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience testing Drupal 10+ applications, Appian integrations, or Login.gov authentication flows.
* Exposure to test automation (Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium).
* Certifications such as CBAP/CCBA, ISTQB, CSM/CSPO, SAFe, or CompTIA Security+.
* Prior support of DOL or another federal enforcement or regulatory agency.
* Experience using DOL-approved AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to accelerate requirements and test case development.

**DOES THIS OPPORTUNITY SOUND LIKE A FIT FOR YOU? IF SO, JOIN OUR TALENT COMMUNITY AND CLICK TO APPLY NOW!!**

**OUR PROFILE:**

We are an IT company with a unique mission—to make people the center of every federal IT solution. Our technologists have always gone the extra mile to help our federal clients succeed. And over the years, we saw a growing disconnect in how federal IT initiatives were built and managed. Time after time, programs failed because the focus was on the tools and products and not the people using them. **LEARN MORE****.**

NuAxis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation. **LEARN MORE** about our Benefits and Culture!

#NAI #DICE

jobs.description:
**Career-defining. Life-changing.**

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**

**Manager, Customer Care Training** & Delivery

**About This Role**

The Manager, Customer Care Training leads the Customer Care training function, including new hire onboarding, ongoing learning, training content, readiness support, and adoption of approved learning technologies. This role is accountable for ensuring training programs prepare employees to perform effectively in a high-volume, regulated, and digitally evolving Customer Care environment.

This role manages Training & Development Specialists and partners closely with Customer Care Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, Support Readiness, Compliance, and other business partners to plan, deliver, and continuously improve onboarding, continuing education, systems training, AI-enabled learning initiatives, and change-readiness support.

The Manager ensures training is consistent, current, measurable, and aligned to operational priorities, quality expectations, compliance requirements, and employee readiness needs. The role uses training data, learner feedback, quality trends, operational metrics, and stakeholder input to identify gaps, recommend solutions, and support responsible adoption of approved AI tools and learning technologies.

**Training strategy, delivery and operations**

* Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Customer Care onboarding, role-based training, continuing education, systems training, refresher training, and change-readiness learning programs.

* Facilitate training or provide coverage as needed.
* Use approved AI and digital learning tools to improve content development, learner engagement, knowledge reinforcement, and scalable training delivery.
* Support evaluation, implementation, and adoption of approved AI-enabled learning solutions in partnership with business, compliance, privacy, and technology stakeholders.

**Employee readiness, performance and training effectiveness**

* Monitor learner attendance, completion, assessment results, proficiency progress, quality trends, and readiness indicators across assigned training programs.

* Identify trends or recurring training needs and recommend appropriate follow-up actions.
* Support employees as they transition from training to production by coordinating reinforcement, coaching support, job aids, and readiness feedback loops with Operations and Quality.
* Use training data, learning analytics, operational feedback, and approved AI-generated insights to identify knowledge gaps, readiness risks, and development opportunities.
* Monitor the effectiveness of AI-enabled learning solutions and recommend improvements to support employee proficiency and performance.

**Learning support for business change and transformation**

* Develop and coordinate training plans for new or updated processes, systems, products, policies, procedures, workflow changes, and technology-enabled ways of working.
* Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand upcoming changes, assess learner impact, define training needs, and align timelines for readiness support.
* Ensure impacted training materials are updated and communicated to trainers and learners.
* Support adoption of new tools, processes, and workflows through training, job aids, coaching resources, reinforcement activities, and stakeholder feedback loops.
* Gather employee and trainer feedback following changes and escalate recurring issues or training needs as appropriate.
* Support training initiatives related to automation, AI-enabled business tools, digital channels, knowledge management, and other technology changes that affect Customer Care operations.
* Assist employees in adopting new digital and AI-enabled solutions through training, coaching, job aids, and reinforcement activities.

**Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure training is delivered in accordance with established company policies, procedures, quality requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Maintain training docume

jobs.description:
Volunteer Program Lead

### **About International Foundation for Autoimmune & Autoinflammatory Arthritis**

We are leaders in advancing education, advocacy, and research for those impacted by autoimmune and autoinflammatory arthritis (AiArthritis) diseases through peer-led guidance, collaboration, and resources that are driven by patient-identified issues and patient-infused solutions.

### **Description**

The International Foundation for Autoimmune & Autoinflammatory Arthritis (AiArthritis) is an international nonprofit organization dedicated to improving the lives of people living with autoimmune and autoinflammatory arthritis diseases through education and awareness, advocacy, research, and extensive community engagement.

As we continue to build our community presence, we are looking for an experienced volunteer program leader to help expand our efforts to build a robust USA presence and improved international presence, including both in person and online opportunities.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Volunteer Program Lead is responsible for growing, maintaining, and leading AiArthritis’ volunteer program. They will initially conduct an audit of the existing program, including all processes, and make recommendations for improvement based on organization goals to expand volunteer opportunities. This role includes recruitment, onboarding, placement, training, engagement, supervision, evaluation, and recognition.

The Volunteer Program Lead will collaborate closely with leadership and program teams to identify volunteer needs, match volunteers to appropriate roles, and support the organization in scaling its initiatives through a robust, well-supported volunteer workforce.

The Volunteer Program Lead will coordinate volunteers for all managers and directors (4-6 individuals).

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Program Development & Strategy**
----------------------------------

* Use professional experience to audit existing volunteer program, identifying areas for improvement, then recommending and implementing new processes.
* Update and implement volunteer role descriptions, expectations, program materials, and manuals.
* Update and implement structures, processes, policies, and workflows.
* Conduct regular organizational assessments to identify volunteer needs across departments.
* Continue building and overseeing volunteer program systems (e.g., CRM, tracking tools).
* Establish risk management protocols, confidentiality guidelines, and compliance standards.

**Volunteer Recruitment**
-------------------------

* Develop and execute recruitment strategies to attract diverse volunteers, including patients, caregivers, and community supporters.
* Lead and track outreach campaigns via social media, newsletters, volunteer platforms, and events.
* Screen, interview, and select volunteers based on program needs and organizational fit.

**Onboarding, Training & Support**
----------------------------------

* Update, standardize, and improve on existing onboarding processes, including orientation materials, volunteer handbooks, and training modules.
* Deliver or coordinate volunteer training sessions specific to various program areas (advocacy, peer support, events, special projects).
* Ensure volunteers understand AiArthritis’ mission, values, and expectations.
* Provide ongoing support, coaching, and supervision for volunteers.

**Engagement, Retention & Recognition**
---------------------------------------

* Create systems to ensure volunteer satisfaction, support, and community-building.
* Develop recognition programs (e.g., awards, spotlights, newsletters, appreciation events).
* Maintain regular communication through email, text, WhatsApp and other volunteer platforms.
* Foster a positive, inclusive environment where volunteers feel valued and connected.

**Program Administration**
--------------------------

* Maintain accurate volunteer records, contact logs, hours tracking, and documentation.
* Evaluate volunteer performance and provide feedback or corrective guidance as needed.
* Track program metrics and produce reports for leadership and the board.
* Be responsible for volunteer scheduling, project assignments, and role transitions.
* Ensure compliance with nonprofit best practices and internal policies.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
----------------------------------

* Work with leadership, communications, patient education, and advocacy teams to integrate volunteers into organizational goals.
* Support events (virtual and in-person), campaigns, and initiatives requiring volunteer participation.
* Partner with the development team to identify volunteers who may transition into donors or who may lead fundraising events or other efforts.

**Program Growth & Innovation**
-------------------------------

* Continuously evaluate program effectiveness and impact. Identify, ideate, and implement improvements as needed.
* Build scalable systems to support significant volunteer expansion.
* Develop specialized volunteer tracks (advocates, peer educators, event support, fundraising, administrative, research ambassadors, high school/young volunteers, corporate employees, professional in-kind skilled services, etc).
* Stay up to date on nonprofit volunteer program best practices and implement trends to stay current.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

### **About The Role**

After becoming one of the fastest growing startups in the United States ($0 $17B), Rippling is ready to up-level our operations to scale to $5B in ARR over the next couple years. We need someone who can take us from 1 to 10—and beyond, on a global scale.

Support Operations manage a global support organization of more than 1,000 employees with a lean team of 10. Our goal isn't just to support the business, but to automate the friction out of it. We are looking for an AI-Native Program Manager to force-multiply our global Support organization through better knowledge management. You will own the internal and external Knowledge roadmap, executing on three core pillars:

* External Knowledge Scaling & Deflection: Drive the expansion and continuous improvement of our external-facing help center, elevating both the quantity and quality of public articles to maximize customer self-service and boost ticket deflection rates.
* Internal Knowledge & Agent Efficacy: Overhaul the structure, clarity, and depth of our internal Confluence space to power high-performance agent-assist tools, ensuring customer support teams have immediate access to accurate, actionable insights.
* AI-First Continuity & Governance: Champion an AI-first approach to data structuring, establishing automated or highly efficient workflows that keep our entire knowledge ecosystem exhaustive, perfectly formatted for LLM consumption, and consistently up to date.

Reporting to the Director of Support Operations, you will be responsible for setting the internal Knowledge roadmap and executing against it to improve Support quality and efficiency.

**What You'll Do**

* **Architect the Dual-Purpose Knowledge Strategy:** Completely overhaul and organize our internal Confluence instance for product, process, and policies. You will establish the frameworks, templates, and structures that make our data instantly readable for humans and optimized for AI chunking/ingestion.
* **Empower Support Leads as an AI Knowledge Consultant:** Work side-by-side with Customer Support Leads to map out top-tier deflection opportunities. You will help them translate messy product updates and tribal knowledge into clear, structured, and accurate documentation.
* **Build the Knowledge Expansion Engine:** Create and scale "text cleaning" and content generation loops for continuity and governance. You will build workflows that automatically capture insights from resolved tickets, Slack threads, and Jira bugs, converting them into polished internal and external knowledge articles.
* **Optimize AI Deflection & Accuracy:** Directly diagnose where our customer-facing AI bots and internal agent-assist tools get confused. You will ruthlessly refine content layouts, semantic keywords, and underlying data structures to eliminate AI hallucinations and boost automated deflection rates.

### **Qualifications**

* **The "Scrappy" Information Architect:** You have 5 – 7 years of experience in Knowledge Management, Technical Writing, Support Operations, or Information Architecture at enterprise scale. You think in data hierarchies, taxonomies, and cross-functional structures.
* **AI-First Operator:** You approach problems with an AI-first mindset, instinctively looking to automate tasks and streamline manual processes before building traditional workflows. You have a proven track record of using generative AI, LLMs, and automation platforms to eliminate administrative overhead, auto-tag documentation, and orchestrate smart information pipelines.
* **Independent Orchestrator:** You are comfortable operating entirely alone as the sole builder of this roadmap. You excel at partnering with busy Support Leads, extraction of complex information, and turning it into organized systems without needing an active development team.
* **Data & System Literate:** You know how to measure the direct ROI of knowledge. You can track support ticket trends, query SQL, analyze deflection metrics, and pinpoint exactly where information gaps are impacting customer satisfaction.
* **Technical Requirements:**
* + Expert-level knowledge infrastructure experience (Confluence, JIRA, Salesforce Knowledge).
  + Deep familiarity with prompt engineering and the LLM landscape (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini).
  + Expertise in SQL/Snowflake to wrangle data and generate insights
  + (Preferable) Expert in text automation and parsing skills (e.g., Zapier, regex, AI content pipelines).
  + (Preferable) Understanding of text chunking, embedding models, and vector retrieval actually work. You know how formatting choices (like clean Markdown or structural HTML) directly affects an AI's ability to pull the right answer

**About the Job:**  
We are looking for a customer-focused, highly organized **B2B Customer Experience Manager** to own and elevate the end-to-end experience for our business customers across bulk purchasing, corporate gifting, and wholesale retail marketplaces.

This role serves as the primary point of contact for business accounts, ensuring a seamless experience from initial inquiry and order placement through fulfillment, delivery, and post-purchase support. The ideal candidate combines exceptional customer service with strong operational execution, relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration to drive customer satisfaction, retention, and B2B revenue growth.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**B2B Customer Experience & Account Support**

* Own the end-to-end customer experience for B2B accounts, including wholesale buyers, corporate gifting clients, bulk purchasers, and marketplace business customers.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for business account inquiries, order updates, product availability, pricing questions, shipping issues, returns, and escalations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business customers through proactive communication, responsive service, and thoughtful problem-solving.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and deliver personalized solutions that support repeat business and long-term account retention.
* Establish consistent service standards and communication workflows across all B2B customer touchpoints.

**Wholesale, Bulk Ordering & Corporate Gifting**

* Manage the customer experience for wholesale, bulk, and corporate gifting programs, from inquiry and quote coordination through order fulfillment and delivery.
* Coordinate large-volume orders, gifting projects, recurring orders, special requests, and time-sensitive deliveries.
* Partner with Operations, Inventory, and Finance teams to confirm product availability, order accuracy, delivery timelines, and customer requirements.
* Support custom order requests, gifting configurations, packaging requirements, gift messages, and other program-specific needs, as applicable.
* Monitor order progress and proactively communicate potential delays, inventory constraints, or fulfillment challenges.
* Identify opportunities to improve program workflows, increase repeat purchases, and strengthen the overall B2B offering.

**Wholesale Retail Marketplace Support**

* Own customer support for business accounts purchasing through wholesale retail marketplaces and other B2B ordering platforms.
* Manage marketplace-related inquiries, order modifications, cancellations, shipment tracking, delivery exceptions, returns, and claims.
* Ensure orders and customer communications align with marketplace policies, service-level agreements, and operational requirements.
* Monitor account and order issues, identify recurring marketplace challenges, and coordinate resolutions with internal teams and platform partners.
* Maintain accurate customer, order, and case documentation to ensure visibility and timely follow-through.

**Order Management & Operational Coordination**

* Oversee the B2B order lifecycle, ensuring accuracy and visibility from order submission through shipment and delivery.
* Partner cross-functionally with E-commerce, Operations, Finance, and Customer Experience to resolve issues and streamline processes.
* Support order entry, quote coordination, invoicing questions, payment follow-ups, shipping arrangements, and account-specific requirements, as applicable.
* Establish clear escalation processes for high-priority orders, fulfillment exceptions, and customer-impacting issues.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend improvements that reduce errors, minimize delays, and improve the customer experience.

**About Assembly Software**

Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.

When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned-up industry.

**Vision Statement**

Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime.

**Mission Statement**

Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers.

**Core Values**

* We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency + feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth + learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions + work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative + open-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer + our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service + add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity + Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.

We don't just sell a product and walk away. We stay. We help our clients build better workflows, train their teams, and actually use the platform they're paying for, and that's what makes our retention numbers something to be proud of.

We're looking for a **Customer Success Manager** who thrives on making clients genuinely successful, not just satisfied. In our POD model, the CSM has a clear and powerful mandate: own the customer relationship, drive adoption, renew confidently, and generate the kind of qualified leads that only come from deep customer trust. You're freed from deal forecasting and transactional selling. Your job is to make customers love Assembly, and let that speak for itself.

You'll own a portfolio of law firm accounts from the moment onboarding ends, running the proactive outreach, health reviews, and training that keep clients engaged and adopting new features. When usage dips or a health score slips, you'll catch it early and act before it becomes a renewal problem. And when you spot the kind of expansion or referral signal that only comes from a trusted relationship, you'll route it to the right team as a real, qualified lead, not just a note in passing.

If this sounds like the seat you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you.

Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)

We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

About Exdion

Exdion is an AI-driven document intelligence company built for insurance brokers and agencies. Our AI suite helps leading brokerages check policies, compare quotes, build proposals and process endorsements with greater speed and accuracy. Our products integrate with the agency management systems brokers already run, so service teams catch errors earlier, reduce E&O exposure and spend more time with clients. www.exdioninsurance.com

The role

You will own the success of some of Exdion's largest client relationships: major US insurance brokerages, typically representing $1M or more in annual revenue each. These programs roll Exdion's policy checking into commercial and personal lines servicing across large, diverse and geographically distributed client teams. They often include an integration with the client's agency management system, such as Applied Epic.

This is a change leadership role as much as an account role. These programs succeed when account managers and service teams across many offices change how they handle policy checking and renewals, and keep doing so. You will be the person who makes that happen, working side by side with each client's PMO, change management team, technology leads and executive sponsors.

You will be someone who has sat in the servicing seat at a P&C brokerage. You know what a renewal cycle feels like in the last two weeks of the month, and you can speak to service teams as a peer.

Key responsibilitiesOwn the client relationship

* Serve as the single accountable owner of the relationship, from executive sponsors to front-line service teams.
* Build trusted relationships with the client's leadership, PMO, change management team, technology leads and regional or practice leaders.
* Run the governance rhythm: weekly working sessions, monthly steering reviews and quarterly executive business reviews.
* Read and navigate the organizational dynamics that come with large-scale change, including competing priorities, leadership shifts and pockets of resistance.

Drive adoption and change

* Partner with the client's PMO and change management team on the rollout plan, sequencing offices, teams and lines of business.
* Identify, recruit and support client champions, and help them lead change within their own teams.
* Map Exdion's policy checking into the client's commercial and personal lines servicing and renewal workflows, including how results flow into Applied Epic.
* Track adoption and utilization by team, spot lagging groups early and put recovery plans in place.
* Translate client feedback into clear requirements and priorities for Exdion's product and delivery teams.

Training and enablement

* Assess training needs and skill gaps across client roles, offices and experience levels.
* Work with the Exdion team to create training material tailored to the client: guides, job aids, videos, workshop content and FAQs.
* Plan and deliver training programs, workshops, office hours and refresher sessions, both in person and virtually.
* Onboard new client users and teams as the rollout expands, and keep material current as the product evolves.

Work across Exdion

* Partner with the VP of Product, Sales leadership and senior management to deliver on commitments and keep the client roadmap aligned.
* Coordinate with implementation, integration and support teams so that issues are resolved quickly and the client hears one voice.
* Report account health, risks and opportunities to Exdion leadership with clear data and a point of view.

Retention, stickiness and growth

* Own account health, renewal readiness and client satisfaction.
* Define success KPIs jointly with each client, covering adoption, utilization, quality and business outcomes, and report against them on an agreed cadence.
* Identify early risk signals, such as falling usage, sponsor changes, unresolved issues or team pushback, and act on them before they become escalations.
* Be relentlessly proactive: anticipate client needs, bring ideas and solutions before being asked, and never let the client chase Exdion for an answer.
* Demonstrate value with measurable outcomes: errors caught, time saved, renewal quality and E&O risk reduction.
* Embed Exdion deeply into the client's standard operating procedures so that it becomes how the work gets done.

Must-have qualifications

* Hands-on experience at a P&C insurance brokerage or agency in a servicing capacity, such as account manager, CSR, account executive or service team leader.
* Deep expertise in commercial lines policy management and the renewal cycle: marketing, quoting, binding, policy issuance, policy checking, endorsements, certificates and stewardship.
* Working knowledge of common agency management systems, with strong preference for Applied Epic. Familiarity with others, such as AMS360, Sagitta or BenefitPoint, is welcome.
* A track record of driving change in collaboration with client or internal teams across a large, diverse and distributed workforce.
* Experience working with PMOs, change management teams and technology leads on multi-office or enterprise-wide rollouts.
* Proven ability to navigate leadership dynamics, build consensus and influence without authority, from the C-suite to the service desk.
* Experience assessing training needs and gaps, building training material, and delivering training programs and workshops.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the presence to lead an executive review and the patience to coach a new user.
* Willingness to travel to client offices as the program requires.

Preferred qualifications

* Experience at a top-100 brokerage, or at a brokerage that has grown through acquisition and runs varied servicing models across offices.
* Prior customer success, implementation or account management experience at an InsurTech or SaaS vendor serving brokers.
* Familiarity with policy checking, E&O risk controls and service center or outsourced servicing models.

jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
Comfrt is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer brands, dedicated to blending mental wellness, inclusivity, and elevated comfort into every piece we create. Our mission goes beyond clothing — we strive to build a community where everyone feels supported and seen.  
  
**About the Job:**  
The Product Operations Specialist keeps every SKU defined the same way across Comfrt's systems, so orders, inventory, and reporting all refer to the same product. This role sits within Operations and owns SKU mapping verification, the connections between systems that carry product data, and the upkeep and troubleshooting that keep those connections working.  
  
**Responsibilities:**

  

**SKU Mapping**

* Confirm and verify that every SKU is correctly mapped across the ERP, e-commerce, warehouse, and marketplace systems so each product has one consistent identifier and attribute set.
* Maintain SKU mapping tables and cross-reference files, and resolve duplicate, retired, bundled, or variant SKUs. Make sure this is being done across all business systems and data warehouses.
* Validate new product and variant setups against the mapping standards before they go live.
* Work with the Master Data Analyst to apply golden-record rules and naming conventions to product data.

**Cross-System Connections**

* Assist in maintain the data connections between systems that exchange product, pricing, and inventory data.
* Configure field mappings, sync rules, and transformations in integration tools, and document each connection.
* Support Ecommerce Team on any needs during product launch set up.
* Partner with BSA Team on new integrations and changes to existing ones.
* Test changes in a sandbox before they reach production and confirm that data arrives correctly downstream.

**Upkeep and Monitoring**

* Monitor sync jobs, integration logs, and error queues on a set schedule.
* Run routine data checks for missing attributes, mismatched SKUs, and stale records, and correct them before they affect orders.
* Keep integration documentation, mapping logic, and runbooks current.

**Troubleshooting**

* Investigate and resolve product data issues, failed syncs, and mismatched inventory or order records.
* Find root causes, not just symptoms, and log recurring issues so they can be fixed at the source.
* Escalate platform or infrastructure problems to BSA or Data Engineering with clear reproduction steps and impact.
* Communicate status and resolution timelines to Operations leadership and affected teams.

**Process and Reporting**

* Build and maintain reports on SKU data health, sync reliability, and open issues.
* Document standard operating procedures for SKU setup, mapping changes, and integration support.
* Recommend process improvements to the Senior Manager of Operations based on recurring issues and data trends.

**Qualifications:**

* 2-4 years of experience in product operations, data operations, supply chain operations, or a similar role that involves product data.
* Hands-on experience maintaining SKU or item master data in an ERP or inventory system, such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Fulfil.
* Practical experience with integration or ETL tools such as Celigo &Boomi including field mapping and troubleshooting sync failures.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data cleanup.
* Working knowledge of e-commerce platforms such as Shopify and their product catalog structure.
* Ability to read logs, trace data through connected systems, and identify root causes.
* Clear written communication for SOPs, runbooks, and issue updates.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage several open issues without close supervision.

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with MDM concepts such as golden records, entity matching, and data governance.
* Experience with SQL or basic scripting for data checks.
* Experience with a Product Information Management (PIM) tool.
* Bachelor's degree in operations, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.

**What Success Looks Like in One Year:**

* SKU mapping accuracy at or above 99% across connected systems, measured by monthly audits.
* Sync failures resolved within 1 business day, with recurring failures traced to a permanent fix.
* Zero unmapped SKUs at product launch.
* Documentation for every active integration and SOP kept current on a quarterly review cycle.

**Why Join Comfrt?**

* Be part of a purpose-driven company that's shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
* Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
* Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
* Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

*Comfort is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.*

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Field Enablement
jobs.description:
**About Nerdio**

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft Cloud and end user computing investments.

Deploying, managing, and cost-optimizing Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Intune is technically complex without a purpose-built management layer on top. Nerdio is that layer. We automate what Microsoft’s native tooling leaves manual, so enterprises and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) can run cloud desktops at scale with lower cost, less operational effort, and less migration risk.

Founded in 2016, Nerdio is used by more than 15,000 organizations in over 50 countries and was named Microsoft’s 2024 Americas Partner of the Year. Our vision is to be the control plane that makes Microsoft cloud workspaces simpler, more efficient, and cost-effective at scale. How much of that opportunity we capture depends on go-to-market execution.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for people who are collaborative, empathetic, driven, and who love to move at the speed of light.

**About the role**

Nerdio is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Field Enablement to be the connective tissue between Product, Marketing, and our direct and partner sales organizations. You will make sure sellers and partners understand our products, our positioning, and our customer value, and can use that story to drive better outcomes for sellers, partners, and customers.

You will partner closely with Nerdio’s Sales Enablement & Readiness team, which leads onboarding, training, certifications, sales methodology, and field execution for sellers and partners. As part of Product Marketing, you will create the messaging, positioning, competitive insights, and content that power these programs. Together, the teams will equip sellers and partners to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Nerdio solutions.

**What you'll do**

* **Translate product into field-ready messaging.** Turn strategy, releases, and positioning into clear value messaging, talk tracks, and proof points for direct sellers, MSPs, and Microsoft co-sell teams.
* **Own launch readiness.** Partner with Product and PMMs on field launch kits delivered ahead of general availability. Collaborate with Sales Enablement & Readiness to establish launch timelines, readiness requirements, and content delivery milestones, enabling Sales Enablement to partner on the training, rollout, reinforcement for field readiness.
* **Build product-led sales content.** Create pitch decks, solution briefs, battle cards, customer stories, and ROI tools tailored to direct and partner motions.
* **Equip partners and co-sell.** Work with Partnerships and Partner Marketing to create partner-ready content that makes MSP, channel, and Microsoft co-sell motions repeatable.
* **Close the feedback loop.** Gather field, partner, and customer insight, including win/loss and competitive intelligence, and turn it into recommendations that sharpen positioning and inform the roadmap.
* **Partner with Sales Enablement.** Align on priorities and supply the product content for their onboarding, training, and playbooks.
* **Use AI to scale.** Speed up content creation and help the field apply AI in their own workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6+ years in B2B technology across product marketing, field enablement, or GTM roles, with experience supporting both direct and partner sellers.
* Proven ability to translate complex technical products into clear value for sellers and varied buyer personas.
* Strong writing and content skills across PMM formats (battle cards, solution briefs, decks, launch kits).

new_jobs.title: Bilingual Program Coordinator Direct Service
new_jobs.description:
**Are you a skilled professional who believes in lending your skills to end hunger during these unprecedented times? If so, consider being the** **Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Service** **for the San Francisco-Marin Food Bank.** Join our friendly, collaborative, and hardworking programs team, reporting to the Program Supervisor.

The Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Service is responsible for providing onsite support at our staff-led Community Markets. This is a fixed term position anticipated to end June 30, 2028.

Who We Are:

**Our mission** is to end hunger in San Francisco and Marin.

**We envision** a just and equitable society that nurtures a resilient community. We envision a community where everyone will have access to nutritious food of their choosing and will be uplifted by a network of support. We work with our community to create lasting solutions to address both the hunger we see today and the root causes that perpetuate food insecurity in our society. Every week, over 50,000 households count on us for food assistance. 60% of what we distribute is fresh fruits and vegetables.

Who You Are:

To excel in this position, you will need to approach the work with the following habits and values:

* **Collaboration and Teamwork:** Partners with others to get work done. Gains trust and support of others. Does own fair share of the work. Seeks assistance from other team members, as needed. Volunteers assistance and undertakes additional tasks to support others. Acknowledges colleagues accomplishments and shares credit on collaborative work.
* **Values Differences/Embraces Inclusion and Diversity:** Seeks to understand different perspectives and cultures. Contributes to a work climate where differences are valued and supported and want to do their best. Self-aware and considerate of how bias, poor treatment and conflict is handled and demonstrates valuing others. Is sensitive to cultural norms, expectations and ways of communicating.
* **Customer Focus/Service Orientation:** Collaborates with colleagues to deliver high-quality service. Actively listens and asks questions to determine participant/volunteer needs. Suggests ways to improve the participant experience. Demonstrates values of caring, respect, honesty, and responsibility in all interacting with staff, volunteers, and participants. Establishes and maintains effective participant/volunteer relationships.
* **Judgement:** Considers the long-term as well as immediate short-term outcomes and actions. Recognizes when to escalate appropriate of specific situations to the next higher level of expertise. Considers alternative available actions, resources, and constraints before selecting a method for accomplishing a task or project. Confirms details before deciding how to act. Seeks out others to check or review their own work for accuracy and completeness. Reviews all relevant information or aspects of a situation before acting or deciding.
* **Self-Awareness and Professionalism:** Reflects on activities and impact on others. Proactively seeks feedback without being defensive. Is open to criticism and talking about shortcomings. Admits mistakes and gains insight from experiences. Is conscious of an manages how ones actions and reactions impact others. Knows strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and limits. Knows how to conduct self in the workplace: communicates effectively, resolves conflict, does not gossip, acts with integrity, and holds professional boundaries.
* **Delivers Commitments:** Follows through on commitments. Acts with a clear sense of ownership. Takes personal responsibility for decisions, actions and failures. Are seen as direct and truthful. Solves issues, rather than focusing on blame. Identifies and communicates what they need of others, and shares that with them directly and professionally.

What You Would Be Accountable for:

The Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Services will be responsible for the following key pieces of work:

* Program implementation: site set up, product receipt, operation, safety and clean-up.
* Volunteer management: train, assign roles and ensure best practices are being followed.
* Site environment: distributions are welcoming and provide a positive experience for everyone.
* Participant support: effectively communicate information and use technology to streamline and track program implementation.

What You Would Be Doing Right Now:

* Provide onsite support at our staff-led Community Markets: volunteer management, grocery distribution, choice management, participant support, and support the co-location with support services.
* Ensure food availability at community markets through food 'ordering', inventory management, and assessment of product movement
* Complete administrative responsibilities, including communicating pertinent information to team members, creating market signage, developing participant written communications, reporting attendance and food inventory, and communicating with participants via ZenDesk.
* Maintain required job knowledge, skills and core competencies. Attend and engage in required trainings and team meetings.
* Represent the Food Bank in the community by engaging with participants, volunteers, partners, and community members.
* Assist in resolving complex and sensitive customer service issues, either in person, by phone, or in writing; maintain records/documentation of customer service issues and/or involve leadership to ensure appropriate resolution
* Support other programs with direct service and/or administrative responsibilities, as needed.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends
* Perform other duties, as assigned.

What Else You Should Know:

**All internal candidates must apply using their Food Bank work email within 10 business days of posting to be considered. Applications submitted after 10 days are still welcome but may not be reviewed or afforded an interview, depending on the status of the selection process.**

new_jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Quality Assurance Manager****- Food Manufacturing**

Hayward, CA | Full-Time | 100% Onsite

  

**Job Description**

The Quality Assurance Manager will manage, coordinate, and implement quality assurance (QA) programs for plant operations. Monitor production, warehouse, maintenance  
and sanitation operations for adherence to quality and food safety programs. Monitor product conformance to quality specifications including complaint investigation and resolution

**This is a full-time, onsite position. Remote or hybrid work is not available.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and maintain the plant’s Food Safety Plan and HACCP program in compliance with the FDA’s food safety rule for manufacturers (FSMA, 21 CFR Part 117)

* Manage the SQF Food Safety Code program and lead preparation for the annual certification audit

* Serve as the primary contact for FDA, state, and local inspections and for customer and third-party audits, and manage all corrective actions

* Oversee the allergen control program, including cross-contact prevention, label checks, and validation of cleaning between product runs

* Partner with the Sanitation team to maintain cleaning schedules and written cleaning procedures, and to verify that equipment is clean before production starts

* Conduct internal GMP and food safety inspections across all shifts, and track findings until they are resolved

* Monitor finished products against quality specifications, and take part in taste and quality reviews and shelf-life testing

* Investigate consumer and customer complaints, find the root causes, and put fixes in place that prevent repeat problems, with a focus on preventing foreign objects in product

* Manage the approved supplier program, including incoming ingredient quality, supplier certificates and specifications, and handling of rejected materials

* Maintain traceability, product recall procedures, and plans to protect products from tampering and ingredient fraud, and run mock recalls at least once a year

* Provide technical support to co-packers and suppliers, including reviews of their allergen and HACCP plans

* Set and report on food safety and quality performance measures to senior leadership

* Deliver GMP, food safety, allergen, and sanitation training to new and current associates, and keep training records up to date

* Lead, coach, and develop the QA team, and support Lean and continuous improvement work across the plant

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Biology, Chemistry, or a related field

* Minimum of 5 years of quality assurance experience in food manufacturing, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or management role

* Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) and HACCP certifications required

* SQF Practitioner certification required, or ability to obtain it within 90 days of hire

* In-depth knowledge of FSMA, GMPs, allergen management, sanitation programs, and GFSI-recognized food safety standards

* Proven experience leading SQF or other GFSI certification audits and regulatory inspections

* Experience in bakery  
  or high-speed packaged food production preferred

* Strong English communication skills, written and verbal. Fluency in Spanish strongly preferred

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, and familiarity with quality, ERP and timekeeping systems

  

**Key Attributes**

* Puts consumer safety first and makes sound decisions, even under pressure

* Stays calm and decisive during audits, deviations, and investigations

* Pays close attention to detail and uses data to solve problems

* Leads visibly on the production floor and earns trust across all shifts

  

**Work Environment**  
The role involves regular work on the production floor, including hot, cold, wet, and noisy areas. Candidates must follow all PPE and hygiene requirements, be able to lift up to 50 lbs, and be flexible to cover multiple shifts as needed.

  

Wisoman Foods Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

**Why work for us?**

* Opportunity to contribute to a growing, mission-driven food company.

* Work closely with a collaborative, passionate team.

* Gain hands-on experience in all aspects of procurement and sourcing in the specialty food sector.
* Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision
* Paid Holidays
* PTO (Vacation and Sick)

new_jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
For more than 50 years, Insight Housing (formerly BFHP) has provided a comprehensive range of housing, food, and support services to help those in need move from homelessness into a safe and affordable home of their own. We serve in seven counties in the Bay Area - Alameda County, San Francisco County, Contra Costa County, Solano County, Sacramento County, San Joaquin County, and Amador County. We are proud of our team members who are very dedicated in our mission *to ensure everyone in our community has a home through supportive, equitable, and sustainable housing solutions.*

**Program Description**

Insight Housing’s VA Grants per Diem Program, Going Home – Berkeley Vets (GHB) is an innovative low demand/low barrier transitional housing services program. We provide comprehensive wrap around services for homeless veterans who are experiencing homelessness, substance use issues and mental health issues. Veterans receive intensive case management, are linked to the medical and mental health capabilities of the VA, and are assisted with obtaining an income and housing.

**Position Summary**

In collaboration with the Senior Program Manager of Roads Home, the Program Manager will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of and staff supervision at the GPD programs in Alameda County. The Program Manager will oversee ongoing training of staff, ensure staff comply with all aspects of the GPD program requirements, and track spending within the program.

The GPD Housing Program Manager will be responsible for outreach, intake and assessment, and permanent housing placement for homeless Veteran’s residing at the Men’s Interim Housing facility or referred from the Regional VA center. This position will engage in developing housing opportunities with the goal being to move homeless Veterans along the continuum from homelessness to permanent housing. A caseload of veterans may be required to ensure coverage.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage the day-to-day operations and contract deliverables of the Alameda GPD program.
* In collaboration with the Sr. Program Manager and Regional Director of SSVF Program, hire, onboard, train, supervise, evaluate, and terminate as necessary all GPD program staff.
* Ensure that clients receive appropriate services as required by our GPD contracts.
* Review and approve all GPD intake files for program eligibility.
* Review and approve all financial assistance requests per GPD guidelines.
* Participate in all VA calls as assigned.
* Maintain files and statistical information and assist with preparation of program statistical reports to comply with government and foundation contracts.
* Oversee development of all individual client service plans, including specific goals, objectives and budget plans.
* Manage a caseload of veterans as required to ensure coverage.
* Conduct crisis intervention as needed.
* Meet with clients to resolve grievances.
* Collaborate with the Continuum of Care (CoC) and the other VA providers in Alameda County to ensure services are delivered efficiently.
* Actively participate in the Veteran By Name List efforts in collaboration with the CoC and other VA providers in Alameda County.
* Participate in weekly meetings with VA liaison, and 2x monthly housing meetings.
* Create and approve staff schedules.
* Facilitate weekly program staff meetings and teleconferences.
* Collaborate with Senior Program Manager to plan and facilitate the House meetings.

* Drive own or agency vehicle to the field and to other program sites, as required; documenting and reporting mileage according to agency procedures, so that services can be provided in a timely manner; comply with agency driving policy at all times.
* Participate in promoting a safe, healthy, and clean working environment consistent with agency’s health and safety practices.
* Attend and participate in all meetings and trainings as assigned.
* Complete and submit own timesheets and approve staff timesheet in a timely and accurate manner.
* Work within the framework of Insight Housing’s Code of Conduct.
* Perform other tasks and projects as assigned.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Abilities**

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Services or related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* Commitment to serving individuals experiencing homelessness. 3 years’ experience providing case management services to homeless individuals, low-income Veterans and/or individuals with mental health or substance abuse issues. Experience in Veterans programming preferred.
* Prior experience in program management and staff supervision strongly preferred.
* Transferable skills, demonstrated leadership and administrative skills, and other relevant experience will be considered.
* Veteran status preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, email, internet, and calendaring applications. Experience with HMIS data entry strongly preferred. Experience with database reporting and extensive data entry.
* Ability to communicate and interact in a supportive and professional manner with colleagues and clients with diverse range of abilities and cultural, racial, gender, and economic background.
* Must possess excellent organizational skills, initiative and follow through, and be detailed oriented.

new_jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

CoreWeave's Strategic Programs and Global Expansion organization delivers the physical capacity behind The Essential Cloud for AI. Within it, the Self-Development group carries sites from acquisition through construction handoff: diligence, entitlements and permitting, pre-development design, utility coordination, and the budget, schedule, and risk controls that bring a site to construction start. The team is small, experienced, and accountable for the critical path on projects that enable CoreWeave's compute growth.

**About the Role**
------------------

This role manages day-to-day execution for assigned self-development sites, partnering with the Principals who lead development strategy and key commercial decisions. You will maintain integrated schedules, track budgets and risks, coordinate internal teams and external consultants, and prepare each site for construction handoff. Principals retain accountability for investment recommendations, material budget and schedule changes, and development decisions.

* Manage integrated project delivery for assigned self-development sites from acquisition through construction handoff, coordinating internal functions and external parties against agreed milestones and dated deliverables.
* Build and maintain the integrated project schedule, including the critical path, milestone exit criteria, dependencies, and deliverables across contributing teams.
* Maintain the Owner's Budget through handoff, including cash flow forecasting, variance reporting against approved capital, and escalation of changes requiring approval.
* Coordinate entitlement and permitting workstreams with development leads and external consultants, maintaining the permit matrix, submittal schedule, and approval dependencies, and supporting relationships with authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs).
* Coordinate diligence and closing workstreams with Legal and technical leads—including title, survey, geotechnical, and environmental reviews—tracking conditions precedent through satisfaction or approved waiver.
* Coordinate delivery across Design, Construction, Power, Legal, Environmental Health and Safety, and Corporate Affairs and Government Affairs, running site meetings and maintaining action logs with named owners and dated commitments.
* Maintain the site risk register, track mitigation actions with named owners, and escalate issues against defined thresholds.

**What we do and why we do it**

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

**How it's going (and growing)**

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of **Stessa** (financial and asset management software), **RentPrep** (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and **Mynd** (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in **Casago** (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

**About the Role**

Roofstock is looking to hire an organized, systems-minded, and experienced Senior Legal Operations Manager to join our Legal team. This individual will own how legal work moves through the business: how it comes in, how it gets tracked, how it gets executed, and how it gets approved and paid. The Senior Legal Operations Manager will build durable workflows in place of institutional memory, keep contract turnaround predictable, maintain clean and complete records, support claims and litigation management in-house, and help manage outside counsel spend against budget. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad visibility, partnering closely with Finance, People Operations, Compliance, and the business teams that depend on Legal to move quickly.

### **Responsibilities**

**Legal Operations & Contract Management**

* Contract Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end contract intake, routing, workflow optimization, and status tracking using Zip.
* First-Line Agreement Review: Perform initial triage and review of incoming third-party agreements in Zip, evaluating red flags, indemnification terms, and standard boilerplate before escalating complex issues to attorneys.
* Process & Self-Service Optimization: Build and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and self-service tools to empower business teams and eliminate attorney bottlenecks on routine agreements.
* Repository & Record Management: Establish repository standards (e.g., Google Drive structure) and manage post-execution filing and signature routing so critical legal records remain organized, current, and accessible.

**Financial Management & Outside Counsel Operations**

* Spend Management & Billing: Oversee law firm billing guidelines, manage outside counsel engagements, and perform initial invoice reviews.
* Finance & Accounting Alignment: Track legal spend against department budgets and collaborate directly with Accounting and Finance on monthly accruals, reporting, and operational friction points.
* Vendor Negotiations: Support rate negotiations with outside counsel and evaluate third-party legal vendors.

**Corporate Governance, Transactions & Claims (Paralegal Support)**

* Entity Management & Cap Table: Manage corporate governance, state filings, annual reports, and registered agent coordination across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Maintain cap table and corporate records in Carta.
* Transaction Support: Coordinate document collection, diligence request tracking, and virtual data room administration (e.g., DataSite) for corporate transactions and financings.
* Litigation & Claims Support: Support in-house claims and litigation intake, issue litigation holds, corporate insurance, coordinate document collection, track deadlines, and liaise with outside litigation counsel.

**Legal Technology & Department Analytics**

* System Administration: Directly administer legal tooling, including Zip (CLM), Carta, e-signature tools, and billing software.
* Reporting & Metrics: Build and maintain operational dashboards that track legal work volume, spend trends, and process bottlenecks for leadership.
* AI & Automation: Identify and implement emerging AI tools and automation to reduce manual workflows while maintaining appropriate review protocols.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of total experience in legal operations, contract management, or paralegal roles, with a strong core background (3+ years) in corporate paralegal responsibilities.
* Experience in a high-growth, late-stage private company (Series B/C/E) or proptech/fintech/real estate environment preferred (public company experience is not required).
* Solid working understanding of key contract terms (indemnification, liability, boilerplate provisions), corporate entity management across multiple jurisdictions, and litigation hold procedures.
* Practical experience with litigation and claims management, including handling matter intake, issuing litigation holds, managing discovery/document collection, tracking critical deadlines, and coordinating with outside litigation counsel.
* Proven ability to partner across business functions, particularly Finance, Accounting, and Human Resources to streamline operational pain points.
* Adaptable "jack-of-all-trades" mindset and self-starter with strong ownership, high discretion, and a natural instinct to systematize and document processes.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
* Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel
* Preferred practical exposure to Zip (CLM), Carta (cap table/entity management), DataSite (VDR), Serengeti/Tracker, or Ironclad
* High degree of ownership, attention to detail, and bias toward action
* Curiosity and willingness to use AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency while maintaining proper validation and judgment
* Real estate, proptech, fintech, or other regulated-industry experience preferred
