new_jobs.title: Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk Operations
new_jobs.description:
Trust & Safety - San Francisco

**About the Team**

At OpenAIs of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role will take on new, ambiguous, or underdeveloped operational risks and help mature them into scalable capabilities. We work across USRO and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Legal, Safety, Support, and external vendors or partnership stakeholders.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Operations Analyst to take on complex, ambiguous safety and risk problems and turn them into practical operational solutions that can scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a versatile operator who is comfortable moving between queues, investigation, analysis, workflow design, hands-on execution, and cross-functional leadership. Depending on team needs, the role may focus on emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployment partnerships, or other new operational areas.

You will be expected to move quickly, work hands-on, and create structure without waiting for perfect requirements or a large support team. The work starts with the problem, not a prescribed process. You may investigate unstructured user signals, stand up a lightweight workflow, build an AI-assisted tool, improve an existing operation, or help a new launch become operationally ready. The goal is to produce durable systems that other people can run, not simply complete a series of individual tasks.

The portfolio will change with company priorities and may span established harm areas, emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployments and partnerships, device safety, or new product launches. Some hires may focus primarily on cloud deployment operations, including launch readiness, partner coordination, safety workflows, and operational monitoring. You will typically own a small number of high-impact problems at a time and will be expected to judge what needs to be built, what can stay lightweight, and when the work is ready to scale, transfer, or stop.

Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office.

***Please note:*** *This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.*

**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of ambiguous, high-priority safety and risk problems: define the problem, gather the right evidence, choose a practical path, drive execution, and close the loop.
* Analyze structured and unstructured data, both quantitative and qualitative. This may include user reports, case narratives, conversations, escalations, and operational metrics to identify patterns, risks, and the highest-leverage interventions.
* Build and test lightweight workflows, tools, automations, and decision aids that improve speed, quality, and consistency, then iterate based on real-world use.
* Turn one-off insights and manual work into scalable operating mechanisms without adding unnecessary process or complexity.
* Lead sensitive investigations, incident response, or launch-readiness work, including safety workflows, human review, escalation paths, partner coordination, and operational monitoring for product launches or cloud deployments.
* Work directly with cross-functional and external partners to clarify ownership, resolve operational gaps, and turn incomplete signals into clear recommendations and decisions.
* Measure whether the work is improving outcomes—such as quality, speed, coverage, operator effort, or risk reduction—and adjust quickly when it is not.
* Help junior operators build judgment and independence through coaching, calibration, and reusable tools.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You**

* Have 8+ years of experience in trust and safety operations, investigations, incident response, product operations, technical program management, or another high-judgment, data-heavy operational field.
* Have a track record as a scrappy generalist who can enter an unfamiliar problem, learn quickly, and deliver with limited structure or support.
* Are highly data savvyation and combine it with quantitative evidence.
* Are technically fluent and hands-on with AI tools, dashboards, and data tooling, and can build or prototype practical solutions without waiting for a dedicated technical team.
* Operate independently, make clear tradeoffs, and maintain momentum as priorities and requirements change.
* Think in systems: you look beyond the immediate task and build approaches that can be repeated, measured, and operated by others.
* Exercise strong judgment in sensitive situations involving user impact, policy, legal risk, technical constraints, and business priorities.
* Communicate clearly and directlyal authority.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in trust and safety, fraud, product safety, integrity, or another adversarial or high-severity risk domain.
* Experience moving a new or immature workflow from early investigation into stable, scaled operations.
* Experience supporting cloud platforms or deployment partnerships, enterprise products, product launches, connected devices, or other technically complex programs. Direct cloud experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Familiarity with SQL, lightweight scripting, no-code tools, workflow automation, or AI-assisted development.
* Experience with vendor operations, quality programs, calibrations, or distributed operational teams.

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

new_jobs.title: Senior Legal Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**What we do and why we do it**

As the leading end-to-end investment platform for single-family rental homes (SFR), our mission is to reinvent the rental housing ecosystem for the benefit of all. We successfully merge our passion for helping investors build wealth through real estate with cutting edge technology that transforms the way they do it.

**How it's going (and growing)**

With a talented team of 750+ Roofsters, our collaborative, can-do culture is what fuels our growth. In 2022, we closed on our Series E, raising $240 million, and have offices in the Bay Area and New York City. Our growth includes recent acquisitions of **Stessa** (financial and asset management software), **RentPrep** (tenant screening and placement service for landlords), and **Mynd** (property management platform for both Retail and Institutional investors). In 2025, Roofstock took an ownership stake in **Casago** (short-term rental management services), expanding our platform to support both long-term and short-term rental investment services.

**About the Role**

Roofstock is looking to hire an organized, systems-minded, and experienced Senior Legal Operations Manager to join our Legal team. This individual will own how legal work moves through the business: how it comes in, how it gets tracked, how it gets executed, and how it gets approved and paid. The Senior Legal Operations Manager will build durable workflows in place of institutional memory, keep contract turnaround predictable, maintain clean and complete records, support claims and litigation management in-house, and help manage outside counsel spend against budget. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad visibility, partnering closely with Finance, People Operations, Compliance, and the business teams that depend on Legal to move quickly.

### **Responsibilities**

**Legal Operations & Contract Management**

* Contract Lifecycle Management: Own end-to-end contract intake, routing, workflow optimization, and status tracking using Zip.
* First-Line Agreement Review: Perform initial triage and review of incoming third-party agreements in Zip, evaluating red flags, indemnification terms, and standard boilerplate before escalating complex issues to attorneys.
* Process & Self-Service Optimization: Build and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and self-service tools to empower business teams and eliminate attorney bottlenecks on routine agreements.
* Repository & Record Management: Establish repository standards (e.g., Google Drive structure) and manage post-execution filing and signature routing so critical legal records remain organized, current, and accessible.

**Financial Management & Outside Counsel Operations**

* Spend Management & Billing: Oversee law firm billing guidelines, manage outside counsel engagements, and perform initial invoice reviews.
* Finance & Accounting Alignment: Track legal spend against department budgets and collaborate directly with Accounting and Finance on monthly accruals, reporting, and operational friction points.
* Vendor Negotiations: Support rate negotiations with outside counsel and evaluate third-party legal vendors.

**Corporate Governance, Transactions & Claims (Paralegal Support)**

* Entity Management & Cap Table: Manage corporate governance, state filings, annual reports, and registered agent coordination across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Maintain cap table and corporate records in Carta.
* Transaction Support: Coordinate document collection, diligence request tracking, and virtual data room administration (e.g., DataSite) for corporate transactions and financings.
* Litigation & Claims Support: Support in-house claims and litigation intake, issue litigation holds, corporate insurance, coordinate document collection, track deadlines, and liaise with outside litigation counsel.

**Legal Technology & Department Analytics**

* System Administration: Directly administer legal tooling, including Zip (CLM), Carta, e-signature tools, and billing software.
* Reporting & Metrics: Build and maintain operational dashboards that track legal work volume, spend trends, and process bottlenecks for leadership.
* AI & Automation: Identify and implement emerging AI tools and automation to reduce manual workflows while maintaining appropriate review protocols.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of total experience in legal operations, contract management, or paralegal roles, with a strong core background (3+ years) in corporate paralegal responsibilities.
* Experience in a high-growth, late-stage private company (Series B/C/E) or proptech/fintech/real estate environment preferred (public company experience is not required).
* Solid working understanding of key contract terms (indemnification, liability, boilerplate provisions), corporate entity management across multiple jurisdictions, and litigation hold procedures.
* Practical experience with litigation and claims management, including handling matter intake, issuing litigation holds, managing discovery/document collection, tracking critical deadlines, and coordinating with outside litigation counsel.
* Proven ability to partner across business functions, particularly Finance, Accounting, and Human Resources to streamline operational pain points.
* Adaptable "jack-of-all-trades" mindset and self-starter with strong ownership, high discretion, and a natural instinct to systematize and document processes.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
* Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel
* Preferred practical exposure to Zip (CLM), Carta (cap table/entity management), DataSite (VDR), Serengeti/Tracker, or Ironclad
* High degree of ownership, attention to detail, and bias toward action
* Curiosity and willingness to use AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency while maintaining proper validation and judgment
* Real estate, proptech, fintech, or other regulated-industry experience preferred

*

new_jobs.title: Program Leader
new_jobs.description:
Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco — Columbia Park Clubhouse  
San Francisco, CA | Monday–Friday, 25 hours/week during the school year and 40 hours/week during summer | Part-time (school year), Full-time (summer)| $24–$25/hr | Benefits Eligible

##### **Why This Role Matters**

Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character and community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a School-Based Club team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

##### **What You’ll Do**

Program Leaders are assigned to a Clubhouse department based on their knowledge and expertise, where they design and lead tailored programs, coordinate and supervise field trips, and independently oversee day-to-day department operations. You’ll play a direct role in shaping the lives of youth in our community, and the position is a stepping stone into Clubhouse leadership.

* Keep members safe — Provide a safe, nurturing environment for every youth in your program.
* Facilitate engaging programs — Create and lead after-school programs and activities for a group of approximately ten members.
* Plan purposeful lessons — Develop age-appropriate lesson plans and activities that promote personal growth, educational achievement, and character development.
* Mentor youth — Serve as a positive role model and mentor, building members’ self-esteem and personal development.
* Cultivate Clubhouse culture — Set standards and expectations grounded in mutual respect between staff and the community we serve.
* Lead field trips — Coordinate and supervise department field trips from planning through return.
* Collaborate with the team — Work alongside junior-level colleagues to meet program goals and share best practices.

##### **What You Bring**

###### **Required**

* Minimum two years of youth development experience working with youth ages 6 to 18 in a youth development setting
* Ability to build strong relationships with youth and create engaging curriculum
* Strong positive discipline skills, with the ability to manage youth behavior and maintain high expectations
* Proven communication, organizational, and self-starter skills
* Strong ability to create and follow systems and procedures in a fast-paced environment with continual distractions

###### **Preferred**

* Education or coursework in Early Childhood Development, Education, or a related field
* Current Red Cross First Aid/CPR certification (or willing to obtain within 90 days of employment)
* Proven leadership or mentorship experience
* Bilingual (Spanish Speaking) candidates are highly encouraged to apply

##### **Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to lift 25 lbs.
* Must be able to stand for at least 2 hours consecutively.
* Must be able to sit at a computer workstation for long periods of time.

##### **Why BGCSF**

* Comprehensive health benefits, including employer contributions
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Education assistance
* Pre-tax Transportation Savings Account
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Generous Paid Time Off program
* Paid Holidays
* Life & Disability Insurance
* Professional development opportunities
* Free all-location West Coast Bay Club membership (for FT & PT after 90 days)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan: Pre-tax savings program with a discretionary employer contribution for eligible employees after completing one year of service.

##### **Compensation**

The wage range for this position is $24–$25 per hour. Final compensation is determined based on a range of factors, including skill set, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs. Candidates may be hired at the entry, mid, or senior level of the range, depending on qualifications and position requirements.

##### **Pre-Employment Requirements**

As part of the hiring process, BGCSF requires candidates to complete LiveScan fingerprinting, a background check, and a tuberculosis (TB) evaluation or test.

##### **Disclaimer**

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work expected in this role. It is not intended as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. BGCSF reserves the right to reassign or relocate employees as needed.

* In partnership with Infra Internal Comms, draft and manage internal communications on behalf of organizational leaders, including long-form posts and live presentations, reorganization announcements and Q&As
* Drive strategic internal initiatives and ensure progress on priority workstreams, help build decision-making frameworks and deliverables
* In partnership with the admin team, we will lead the planning and execution of all-hands and offsite events

new_jobs.title: Technology Training Specialist

At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

The Technology Training Specialist (MRX Expert) is a marketing-based education and experience role in the Monogram Robotics Expert (MRX) Team. The MRXs serve as platform experts and educators responsible for training, knowledge dissemination, and high-quality external demonstrations of the Monogram robotic system.  
This role supports education and enablement across all Zimmer Biomet functions—including Marketing, Sales, Clinical, and Medical Education—by delivering consistent, best in class robotic knowledge and programs. Externally, MRXs represent Monogram at congresses, medical education programs, workshops, and events, helping shape perception, credibility, and excitement around the robotic platform.  
MRXs do not own sales accounts, and do not provide routine clinical case coverage or post-sales clinical application support tied to sales activity.

* This role IS:
  + A marketing led education and experience role
  + Focused on training, demonstrations, and knowledge leadership
  + Responsible for scalable education across ZB and external audiences
  + A visible ambassador of Monogram robotics at congresses and events
* This role is not:
  + A clinical field sales specialist
  + An account aligned sales support role
  + Routine intraoperative coverage during the sales process

**We are hiring for multiple positions across the USA.**

This role is territory-based and supports business growth in assigned regions.

**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------

Up to 70%. This is a remote, field-based position with high travel.

  + Maintain deep knowledge of robotic-assisted surgery, competitive landscape, and evolving standards.
  + Ensure consistent, accurate, and compliant education across all audiences.
  + Provide structured feedback to Marketing, Clinical Affairs, and R&D

  + Execute curricula developed by the MRX Manager and Marketing.

* Congresses, Events & Medical Education Programs
  + Represent Monogram robotics at:
    - National and regional congresses

    - Product exhibitions and demonstrations
  + Deliver high quality system demonstrations focused on education and awareness.
  + Ensure a premium, consistent Monogram experience at all events.
  + Partner with Marketing and Corporate Comms to align with brand narrative and messaging.
